$comment: Voice: written from inside the crawl. Events as events, in the dungeon's own vocabulary. Never 'in book 4 Carl does X', never 'the series', never 'four books later' — the reader's position is the gate's job, not the prose's. confidence: 'verified' = drawn from the Fandom wiki's chapter record or an entity page. 'draft' = written from reading knowledge, awaiting a pass.

entities.name: Carl
entities.tagline: Twenty-seven. Coast Guard, marine technician. I went outside for a cigarette, and that is the only reason I'm alive. I'm not sure it counts as a reason.
entities.voiceNote: Deadpan, first person, understated. Notices the practical detail first (footwear, inventory, what will explode) and the feeling second, if at all. Gallows humour, never grandiose, never asks for sympathy. Says Donut, Mordecai, the AI. Swears in the crawl; here he keeps it to hell and damn. Talks like a man narrating a repair job while the building is on fire.

beats.headline: January 3rd, 2:23 in the morning
beats.text: I crack the window of my apartment in Seattle for a cigarette. That's it. That's the whole decision. Donut, who is my ex-girlfriend's show cat and not mine in any way I agreed to, goes out through it and up the tree, and I go after her into the freezing dark in my leather jacket, boxers and Bea's pink Crocs, with a Zippo and half a pack of Marlboro Reds. Mrs Parsons leans out to ask about the noise. Then every building on the planet comes down at once, and everyone who stayed inside one is gone.

beats.headline: Dressed for nothing, and stuck that way
beats.text: An hour past the stairs and I have a Goblin Pass Tattoo on my left forearm, a Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling, a Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness clipped to the jacket and a Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk. What I do not have is shoes. I have asked. The dungeon has heard me ask, and the dungeon has an opinion about it.

beats.headline: The footwear situation does not improve
beats.text: The second floor finally addresses my feet. It hands me an Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph. So now I am still barefoot, but my feet are shiny and they glitter, and the audience has noticed, and the audience does not let things go.

beats.headline: Primal, and a Compensated Anarchist
beats.text: Class selection, on the way into the Over City. I take Primal for the race and a monk-rogue hybrid nobody has picked before, and the AI writes me up as "a trapmaking, bomb-making, social-media dynamo" who "will happily throw a Molotov through a window one moment and step in front of a camera to plead for the violence to stop the next." I'd argue with it if I could think of the argument.

beats.headline: The twenty-fifth holder of the Cookbook
beats.text: Twenty-four crawlers carried this before me. Different seasons, different species, worlds that aren't there any more. Whatever I do from here, I'm finishing somebody else's work, and most of them never got to finish theirs.

beats.headline: The Tangle cannot be beaten alone
beats.text: The trains only come apart if hundreds of crawlers move at once, and getting hundreds of crawlers to do anything at once is exactly the thing production spends its money preventing. So I stop thinking of the explosives as the weapon.

beats.headline: He worships a god to survive a plane crash
beats.text: I am falling out of the sky and Quan Ch is about to finish the job. So I take Emberus as my patron, mid-air, and throw a celestial grenade. The god arrives at my position, and for a little while nothing can kill me. Then Emberus finds Orthrus, and both of them are gone.

beats.headline: Agent Provocateur
beats.text: The Hunting Grounds are opening and I take the bomb-focused specialisation. Agent Provocateur. I would like to be very, very good at exactly one thing, and I have picked the thing.

beats.headline: Zockau burns
beats.text: Zockau burns. I mark hunters with the Ring of Divine Suffering, I kill them, and I take their stats, and enough of them are inside the Desperado Club when it goes that the survivors have to be dug out. I get hurt on the way out. That part is fair.

beats.headline: He takes command of one of nine armies
beats.text: Thirty days. A castle at Larracos, dead centre of the map. No coming back from a death on this floor, for anyone. Supply, alliances, atrocity, at a scale where the arithmetic stops being about people I know.

relations.note: The Royal Court, such as it is.

entities.name: Princess Donut
aka: Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk
entities.tagline: I am a pedigreed tortoiseshell Persian with a bedroom full of ribbons and a very good voice. I do not see what more you could possibly need to know.
entities.voiceNote: Imperious, delighted by herself, wounded by any slight and quick to say so. CARL in capitals when he is being difficult; Mordecai is staff. Uses her titles in full and treats them as facts. Things are common, vulgar, rude or unfair. Never swears, because swearing is common. Mongo is her son and she will not be told otherwise.

beats.headline: First cat down the stairs
beats.text: Carl carries me down, and the dungeon gives him a Legendary Pet Box for it, which is fair, and gives me a Legendary Quadruped Box of my own, which is more than fair. His box has a biscuit in it. An Enhanced Pet Biscuit. I take it out of his hand, because it is obviously for me, and I melt into a heap of goo, and I get up talking. I have a great deal to say.

beats.headline: GC BWR NW Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk
beats.text: I learn Magic Missile. I also have the highest stat total in the party, which makes me party leader, which anyone could have predicted. My first act is to give the party a proper name: the Royal Court of Princess Donut. There is an inauguration. Carl does not take it seriously enough, but there is an inauguration.

beats.headline: She equips a crown with an ominous description
beats.text: Mordecai says read the description first. Mordecai says a great many things. It is a crown, it is dark and smoky and exactly my colour, and it came out of my box, which has the word Legendary on it. It has a vulgar name, which is not my fault. It says something about the Blood Sultanate and a line of succession, eight floors down. I am already a princess. I do not see how being in line for anything could be a demotion. Carl is making his face.

beats.headline: She adopts a dinosaur
beats.text: There is a reward room on the second floor with a cage in it, and in the cage is a pet-class mob, and the pet-class mob is my son. I did not know that until I saw him. He is called Mongo. He is mine, and that is the end of the discussion.

beats.headline: Cat, and a Former Child Actor
beats.text: Odette suggested it, so obviously it is a good idea: a class that lets me choose another class at every level. I also arrange for Mordecai to be my manager. He is thrilled. He does not show it, but he is. My constitution is apparently far too low for what Carl calls melee, so I will be fighting with charisma, spells and the audience, which is how it should be done.

beats.headline: She fights with people
beats.text: It is a card floor and I have a deck, and Shi Maria is going into it. She is somebody, which is not the same thing as a mob with a number over its head. Carl saw straight through her and made an arrangement: she becomes a card, and we take her down to the next floor with us. I will play her when I need her. It is a game. That is what the cards are for.

beats.headline: The crown comes due
beats.text: The Blood Sultanate is on this floor, and every royal in the line must slay the Sultan and all the other members of the royal family before descending to the tenth. I am a royal in the line. I have been since the first floor. I would like it noted that I was told to read the description.

relations.note: She considers him her son. He agrees.

entities.name: Mongo
entities.tagline: MOTHER. Food. MOTHER. Bite anything near Mother.
entities.voiceNote: Does not talk. What the camera gets is the dinosaur: single words, capitals, appetite. MOTHER is Donut. Everything else is FOOD, NOT FOOD, or BAD. Never more than a few short lines.

beats.headline: Seven inches of pink feathers, in a cage
beats.text: CAGE. Small. Pink? Pink. TWO BIG THINGS. Bite them. Bite them. Bite. MOTHER. Mother has grubs. Grubs open. Inside part GOOD. Mongo stays.

beats.headline: He stands over her
beats.text: Mother down. Mother NOT MOVING. Mongo on top of Mother. Spiky things. MANY spiky things. Bite. Bite. Bite. Hurts. Mongo stays on Mother. Carl says something. Mongo does not listen to Carl.

beats.headline: He finishes Maggie My
beats.text: Thing on Chris. Thing OFF Chris. Thing goes for Carl. Thing is FOOD.

beats.headline: Nearly lost, and then a father
beats.text: Mongo, dinosaur, registered pet of Crawler Princess Donut, has survived the ninth floor. This was not the expected outcome. Credit goes to a knight called Sir Rendlegore, who pulled him out. Mongo is also, as of the stairs, a father. Nobody is going to explain that to you, least of all me.

entities.name: Mordecai

tagline.text: Your guide for the first three floors. I have done this before. Listen, and you might get to see the fourth.
I crawled once. It cost me everything I had, and Borant still owns what's left.

entities.voiceNote: Tired professional, precise about rules, exasperated by clients who ignore them. Leads with the warning, follows with the reason, ends with a sigh you can hear. Kid, listen, you don't get it. Bitter about Borant in short sentences. Does not gush and does not comfort; drunk, he talks about the past and stops himself.

beats.headline: Tutorial Guild Hall, first floor
beats.text: Rule one: I don't open the door until you kill a goblin. The cat desecrates my mother. The man blows up a Murder Dozer. I open the door. My name is Mordecai. Borant holds my indenture, which means I guide for the first three floors and run a magic guild after that, where they mostly leave me alone to brew and look up old friends. Try to live long enough for that to matter.

beats.headline: He has done this before, and it cost him everything
beats.text: I crawled. I took Changeling, and I can't shift on my own any more, so the dungeon hands me a body at the start of every floor and I wear what I'm given. This one is a rat-kin. What I actually am is golden, and has wings. I don't talk about the family. When I've had enough to drink, I talk about the family.

beats.headline: Manoeuvred into managing a cat
beats.text: Odette says my memory is the most valuable thing a crawler could get hold of, so the two of them arrange for me to become the cat's manager during class selection, and they make it look like an accident. It was not an accident. I will forgive Donut. Carl, no.

beats.headline: The rules he cannot break
beats.text: Most of what I know I'm not allowed to volunteer. Some of it I can only give you if you ask the exact question. Without press credentials nobody watching can see me or hear me, and as a manager I can't touch a mob. My advice is what it has always been: stay ahead of the curve, never trust an elite, stay away from gods. Carl has heard all three.

beats.headline: Huanxin, Uzzi, and what happened
beats.text: Odette is in the middle of this crawl now, so the old story is going to come out. Chaco. Uzzi. A stairwell that would not open unless a god was struck down, and me volunteering to do the striking, because the only life it cost was mine. Odette found a cheaper way to pay. She talked Chaco into putting the dart into my brother instead. She had a bargain with Huanxin Jinx and she tore it up rather than sign away her bonus, and Uzzi is what she spent in its place. I walked out of that stairwell. He did not. I do not talk about it sober.

entities.name: Katia Grim
entities.tagline: Art professor, Reykjavík. Apparently I can mould my own mass like clay. I am working out how, and you can tell.
entities.voiceNote: Quiet, exact, self-critical. An academic's vocabulary used plainly; dry about her own face and her own standing. Puts other people first and says so as fact, not virtue. Grief is stated once and not decorated. Carl and Donut by name; Eva by name, without explanation.

beats.headline: Ten levels behind and nobody's problem
beats.text: I came in with Eva. We fell in with Hekla and Brynhild's Daughters, who carried the two of us through a neighbourhood boss and a borough boss, and I know exactly how much of that was us. Class selection split us up, and Eva did not wait. Now Hekla is asking Carl and Donut to take me. The system has just upgraded my displayed race from "What the f-word?" to "Human", so things are looking up.

beats.headline: Doppelgänger, Monster Truck Driver
beats.text: Bannon, my guide, talked me into it: a momentum-based constitution tank who can reshape her own mass, body and equipped gear together, into any form of the same weight. I sculpted my face using my reflection in a health potion bottle. Carl says it looks like a Juan Gris. He is being kind, and I would know.

beats.headline: She spends a death sentence saving NPCs
beats.text: The Fools Who Broke the Glass quest is close to unsurvivable, and it triggers before I have earned my place. I spend the time getting NPCs out. I tell Carl and Donut to save themselves. I mean it.

beats.headline: She kills Ghazi and takes his notes
beats.text: The sand ooze is dead and the walls are coming in. I get out with Ghazi. Then I kill him, for the notes that explain how the Gate works. Carl and Donut are still buried when I do it. I know how that sounds.

beats.headline: She turns the watches into a map
beats.text: The linked watches read as a reverse compass: a time, an altitude, an exact position relative to anywhere else. Which means the Gate could open onto the city of Larracos, on the ninth floor, and I am mapping ground nobody has stood on.

beats.headline: She takes the Orchid and walks out
beats.text: Crawler Katia Grim has left the dungeon. Not by the stairs. She ate the Orchid of Eileithyia's Grace, spent an hour at one percent, and walked out human, or a version of human. Not all of her came back with her. Don't ask me where the rest went.

entities.name: Imani

tagline.text: Out of the Meadow Lark Elder Care Facility. I'm nowhere near finished, and I won't be rushed.
Out of Meadow Lark, and holding a portal open on the racing floor until everyone who's coming is through.

entities.voiceNote: Calm, steady, a caregiver's voice under pressure. Counts people, says what needs doing, does it. Warm without fuss, firm without volume. Carl, Donut, Elle, Yolanda, Brandon and Chris by name. Never dramatises a loss and never leaves before the last one is through.

beats.headline: The good folks from Meadow Lark
beats.text: We came down out of Meadow Lark, the elder care facility, together: Yolanda Martinez, the Andrews brothers, Brandon and Chris, me, and Agatha, who none of us can quite place and who came with us anyway. Carl and Donut find us, and we sit down and trade stories, theirs and ours, and then we make a plan, because there are people depending on us and a plan is what you owe them.

beats.headline: The Ball of Swine
beats.text: Seven of us against the Ball of Swine: Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Carl, Donut, Agatha and me, fighting from the redoubt. It is the first time this group has fought as one thing instead of six people and a cat standing near each other, and it works. Afterwards I count everybody twice, because that is what I do, and everybody is there both times.

beats.headline: She holds the portal open
beats.text: I open the portal again, and I hold it. Louis comes through, and the crawlers from the multi-crawler heats come through behind him, and I keep it open until the last of them is on this side. Everybody else goes back to the track, crosses the finish line, and takes the stairs. Somebody has to stand at the door. It's usually me, and I'm all right with that.

tagline.text: Agatha. Travelling with the Meadow Lark party. Her file is thinner than it should be, and I keep very good files.
Agatha. Formerly of the Meadow Lark party. A warlord has just called her an enemy to all of you. He did not elaborate. Neither will I.

beats.headline: The mysterious Agatha
beats.text: Agatha. She is with the Meadow Lark party when Carl and Donut find them: Imani, Yolanda Martinez, the Andrews brothers, and her. The others I can account for, level by level, box by box, all the way back to the stairs. Agatha I can account for. Mostly. Let's leave it there. The party calls her mysterious, which is the kindest word available and also the most accurate.

beats.headline: She fights beside them, then takes her leave
beats.text: For the record: Agatha fought the Ball of Swine from the redoubt beside Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Imani, Carl and the cat, and did her share. Then, in the aftermath, while everyone else was agreeing to keep helping Meadow Lark, she took her leave. No forwarding address. I nearly always have a forwarding address.

beats.headline: Akuma's warning
beats.text: Warlord Akuma, to the Warlord Chat: the War Mages are leaving the floor, and they have found the Scavenger's Daughter and are taking her with them. Then, to Carl and Donut specifically, a warning. Agatha is an enemy to all of you. His words, not mine. He did not elaborate, and I am the referee here, not the colour commentary, whatever it may look like from where you're standing.

entities.name: Elle McGibbons

tagline.text: A woman my age, hauled through a safe-room door by the armpits by a barefoot young man with a cat. Do not tell the others. They will want details, and I intend to embellish.
I have my own squad now, and we have just walked into a church full of friends. Not bad for a woman who was once hauled into a safe room by the armpits.

entities.voiceNote: Old, loud, and pleased about both. Short declaratives, jokes about her age before anyone else can, flirts with Carl to watch him squirm. Says Carl, or young man when she is enjoying herself; Imani by name. Never asks to be looked after and never pretends she did not need it.

beats.headline: Carl gets her inside
beats.text: The next episode is tunnelling through and I am not, at my age, built for sprinting. Carl, the young man with the cat, takes hold of me and hauls me into the safe room like a sack of feed, and I let him, because I am old and not stupid. Then the ceiling announces Rage Elementals. Of course it does. The day was missing a garnish.

beats.headline: At the church with the rest
beats.text: The church, and it is full. Imani is there, and then Katia's people, and then Li Na's, and then mine. My own squad. Every one of us got here on a Doggy Door upgrade that Lucia handed round before she took the stairs down. I do not know what that girl is. She gave us a way through, and I am standing in a church with my friends because of it, so I will say thank you and keep the rest of my opinions where they belong.

entities.name: Zev

tagline.text: Hi. Zev. I am production's point of contact with the Royal Court, which means anything about your appearances goes through me, and anything I am allowed to tell you, I will. The rest I am not allowed to tell you, and it is not because I don't want to.

I am production's point of contact with the Royal Court. Officially, that is the whole job. Unofficially, Princess Donut and Mordecai have both seen Gossip Girl, and I have seen every episode, and I am not going to pretend that isn't relevant.

entities.voiceNote: Brisk, kind, and permanently worried about her job. Speaks in the cadence of a scheduling message: Okay, so; I need you to; I am not supposed to say this. Carl and Princess Donut, always in full. Never swears, never speculates on air, never says more than she is allowed and always says exactly as much.

beats.headline: She explains how the shows work
beats.text: Okay. So. Carl has just met his first Borant dungeon admin and managed to be civil, which I am counting as a win for everyone, including me. My job today is to walk them through how crawlers take part in the Syndicate programmes, and I get through all of it. Then Princess Donut mentions Gossip Girl, and Mordecai has seen it, and I have seen it, and for a few minutes nobody in the room is anyone's liaison.

beats.headline: She reminds him the contract stands
beats.text: Carl. I know you have a lot going on. I know the Hunting Grounds are the Hunting Grounds. I still have to say this, because saying it is my job: your agreement with the Vengeance of the Daughter programme is still in effect. Nothing you signed on an earlier floor stops mattering because you have gone down a set of stairs. It doesn't work like that. Please don't make me be the one who has to remind you twice.

entities.name: Tsarina Signet

tagline.text: Tsarina Signet. Yes, look. They all look, and I have never once had to ask them to.
A murdered mother, a crown taken by the Confederacy, and exile from both halves of my blood. Grimaldi's circus took me in. Everything I have goes to the family that did.
It is a programme. My mother's murder, my exile, my vengeance, all of it arranged for an audience across the galaxy, with someone outside deciding when I grieve and whether it rates.

entities.voiceNote: Grand, wounded, theatrical; every sentence is a line delivered from a stage. Speaks of blood, oaths and vengeance without irony and never apologises. Carl is Carl or crawler; Donut is Donut, or the cat; Grimaldi is always spoken of with tenderness. Never says show or programme until she learns there is one.

beats.headline: Met outside Grimaldi's circus
beats.text: Night comes down on the Over City and the mobs form their lines around Grimaldi's Traveling Circus. Two crawlers have come to scout it, a man and a cat, and they leave under magical mortar fire, and I am what they run into on the other side. My charisma stands past a hundred. He stares, as they all stare. Then he snaps his own finger, and it breaks. I have not decided whether to be offended.

beats.headline: Carl signs on to her show
beats.text: Grimaldi has lifted my banishment. Carl went into his head to ask him, and I asked with him. I may leave the circus behind me at last and go where my vengeance waits, and that is the sixth floor, not here. Carl has agreed to be part of it as well, the Vengeance of the Daughter, when it comes to its proper act. Before he went in he sat and read a spellbook. Wisp Armor. It guards the mind against control, and he wanted it on him before he swallowed the worms that let Grimaldi speak inside his skull. He does not walk into another creature's mind unarmoured. Nor would I.

beats.headline: Daughter of King Finian, and of nobody
beats.text: I am the daughter of King Finian of the High Elves of the Liana Sector, and of a Naiad princess. She was murdered, and the Confederacy took her crown. Both halves of my family then agreed on one thing, which was that I should not exist among them. I was a child. Grimaldi's circus took me in when no throne would. That is the whole of my inheritance: a name, an exile, and a tent.

beats.headline: Blood magic, cast on a loser
beats.text: The tattoos move under my skin because they are not pictures. They are Blood and Ink Elementals, and I raise them. The craft is exact. I set two creatures against each other and I cast on the one I judge will lose, before it has taken a single wound. I may not bleed the sacrifice myself; that is the law of it. Only the killing blow, struck by another hand, releases what I need. One summoning a night. Judge badly and the night is wasted.

beats.headline: Her loyalty does not extend to crawlers
beats.text: I will say it plainly, since the crawlers already know. I tried to make Carl my blood sacrifice, and not with his consent. I put Donut under the Water Lily Spell. I made him bring me to the cursed circus when he had other places to be. I do not regret one piece of it. Everything I have is owed to the family that took me in when no other would, and a crawler is not family.

beats.headline: She hears what Carl was trying to tell her
beats.text: Carl tried to tell me and I would not hear it. I hear it now. My mother's murder, my exile, the circus, the vengeance I have carried since I was a child: it is a programme. It is watched across the galaxy. There are people outside this floor who decide when I grieve and when I strike, and who count how many are watching while I do it. I understand him now.

entities.name: Redstone Grimaldi
entities.tagline: Redstone Grimaldi, ringmaster of Grimaldi's Traveling Circus. Also the man who took Signet in, which is the only line of his file anyone ever asks about.

beats.headline: The circus in the Over City
beats.text: Grimaldi's Traveling Circus is pitched in one of the Over City's districts. Ringmaster Redstone Grimaldi, proprietor. Tonight two crawlers, Carl and Princess Donut, are scouting the grounds as the mobs form up for the night. That is the whole entry so far: a tent, a company, and two people looking at it from the dark. Filed under Over City, third floor.

beats.headline: He named her Tsarina
beats.text: Background, for the file. Grimaldi pulled a half-Naiad child out of the hands of the High Elves and raised her in his circus. The child grew up. The child fell in love with him. She told him once that had she been full-blooded Naiad she would have been a tsarina, so he made it her name, and Tsarina Signet is what she has answered to since. Ringmasters name things. It is most of the job.

entities.name: Samantha
entities.tagline: I am a GODDESS. Half of one. In the head of a sex doll. You are going to hear about it.
entities.voiceNote: Loud. Capitals for the loud parts. Filthy-minded, self-obsessed, theatrical; wounded by being ignored and never quiet about a grievance. Carl, Donut, Mother. Talks about her missing body the way other people talk about a stolen car. Never humble, never grateful for longer than one sentence.

beats.headline: The head from Ghazi's castle
beats.text: Yes, I am a head. Yes, THAT kind of head. Get it out of your system. I am Psamathe, or the half of her that got stuck when I tried to climb out of the Nothing, and what I got stuck in is a Lika doll from Ghazi's castle, crystallised until now. Withering spirit, the system calls it. Carl carried me here in his pack like a snack. Now he is HIRING me. A goddess. As a trainer. Kept in the safe room. Fine. FINE. I want a mirror.

beats.headline: Her mother comes when called
beats.text: Slit. A feral demon, and it is hunting ME, like I do not have enough going on. So they open the safe room and roll me out to deal with it, which is apparently a plan: one head versus one demon. Fine. I call for Mother. Mother comes when I call. Mother kills Slit, and everyone here is now looking at me the way they should have been looking at me from the start.

beats.headline: She wants her body back
beats.text: SIGNET. Take me to Signet. Signet can put me back in a body, a real one, with all the parts, and I have been saying so since they walked in and nobody is LISTENING. Carl has the face he makes when he wants to put me back in the bag. He says they will bring me if I shut up. So I am shutting up. This is me. Shut up. Are we going or not?

beats.headline: A new friend who can cast it
beats.text: Carl. Donut. FINALLY. I have made a friend. Her name is Shi Maria, and she can cast the spell. The spell. The body one. I have been telling everyone for two floors that this is possible, and now I have someone who can actually do it agreeing with me, so everyone can stop making that face. Come and get me so I can introduce you. I have a lot to tell you and none of it is quiet.

entities.name: Shi Maria

tagline.text: I am Samantha's new friend. She has been without a body for so long, poor thing, and I can give her one. Ask her. She will tell you how kind I am.
I let them make me into a card, and in return they carry me to the next floor. Then I win them their floor, more or less by myself. You are welcome.
They carried me down as a card, as agreed. I am not in the card now.

entities.voiceNote: Honeyed and unhurried, a performance she can drop mid-sentence and pick back up. Sweet to Samantha, frank with the man. Speaks of herself as a gift and of everyone else as a means. Never sounds threatened, never raises her voice, never says what she actually wants.

beats.headline: Carl sees through the act
beats.text: I have been putting on a little performance, for Samantha's benefit. She likes it. The man does not; he sees through it before I have finished the first act, which is rude, and rare. So we make a different deal, he and I. I let them turn me into one of their cards. In exchange, they carry me down to the next floor. I find I do not mind being carried.

beats.headline: She wins the floor
beats.text: The key-holder is a Reminiscence Hydra of Malicious Compliance, and it brings totems: an Alpha Male Carl and a King Croissant. I do most of the work. I do not say that to be unkind; they would say it too. In the middle of it the man looks away from the hydra and into my eye, my magic eye, and I do a small thing to him while he is looking. What it does is my business.

beats.headline: Inside him, and not staying quiet
beats.text: Field ruling, ninth floor. Commander Stockade of the Lemig Sortion tried to pull Crawler Carl bodily to his position. Mordecai, at the same moment, tried to force Shi Maria out of him. Each got half. What came of it is Shi Maria loose in the Lemig base, and the mess she made there, which the adjutant Panford has been left to explain to everyone. Stockade looked into her eye. Stockade is no longer with us, by his own hand. The Lemig Sortion is being punished for cheating, and the ceasefire is over early.

entities.name: Juice Box

tagline.text: Juice Box. Changeling. Prostitute, professionally. Louis brought me along, and I would have come anyway.
I went into the water on the fifth floor as somebody's plus-one. I came out of it with a title and a message, and the message is the dangerous part.

entities.voiceNote: Cheerful, blunt, no shame and no filter about her trade or her body. Loves Louis and says so; loves things that go bang. Short declaratives, one idea each. Calls people by name or by what they are. Never apologises and never explains herself twice.

beats.headline: Louis brings her
beats.text: Louis found me and Louis brought me, because he is sweet and because I asked. Now the other crawlers in the quadrant have found Carl's group, and Carl's group has a cat who talks. Their manager, Mordecai, is sobering Louis and Firas up on the spot. All the fun is coming out of their blood at once. Louis looks very sad about it. I am not sad. I am here, and I am staying.

beats.headline: Waiting on the last stage
beats.text: Carl and Donut and me, sitting on our hands while Katia goes to the water quadrant. The last part of the plan is Carl's, and Carl does not say what the last part is until it is already happening. I like plans like that. I like the part where things happen. Louis is somewhere else, and I would like it on the record that I would rather he was here. There. It is on the record.

beats.headline: Through the portal with the water
beats.text: I went through the Gate with the water. I lay low with the ones who lived through it, and when they were ready I told them. What they are. What this whole place is. Enough of them believed me that they call me Warlord now, and a Warlord has people, and a Warlord has opinions about alliances. I have sent War Leader Arief to Carl's people with my terms. The terms are Louis. He marries me. That is the alliance.

entities.name: Louis

tagline.text: Louis. Me and Firas were out in the desert with a team of car salesmen who have bows now. Then Carl's crew showed up. It's been a week.
Found in a desert on the fifth floor. Tenth floor now, and still leaving through other people's portals. It's a system. It works.

entities.voiceNote: Easygoing, a beat behind and fine with it. Okay so, man, no joke. Finds most things kind of funny, including the parts that aren't. Firas is his buddy. Never sounds scared, never sounds impressed, never plans further than the next thing.

beats.headline: The desert quadrant
beats.text: Okay so, me and Firas are out in the desert with Langley's guys, who are, no joke, car salesmen. With bows. Pretty good with the bows. Then Carl's crew comes over the dune looking for other crawlers, and, hey, found some. We all head for the Bactrian town together, and a Thorny Devil and a Gnomish Drop Bear have thoughts about that, so we head back to Hump Town instead. Not a loss, man. A regroup.

beats.headline: Out through Imani's portal
beats.text: Racing floor. Some of us drew heats with other crawlers in them, which is the bad kind of heat, and Carl's got a plan for it, because of course he does. Imani has the portal open again. So me and everybody else from the mixed heats are going through it. Not my portal. It's never my portal. I've been walking through other people's doors since the fifth floor and, honestly, no complaints.

entities.name: Tran

tagline.text: Tran. Gwen found the valve. I opened it. There was a necropolis to flood and two crawlers under it.
Gwen and I flooded a necropolis, and I walked out of a boss fight through a hole in reality. Both on purpose. I would do the first one again.

entities.voiceNote: Few words, all of them load-bearing. What happened, then what the options were, in that order, no decoration on either. Dry rather than grim. Carl, Katia, Gwen by first name. Never speculates, never boasts, never says how he feels about any of it.

beats.headline: He opens the valve
beats.text: Carl and Donut are under the sand. The tomb is coming down and there is no digging them out, not in the time we have. Gwen and I find the valve. We open it. Water goes in, the tomb floods, and everything loose in there, the two of them included, goes wherever the water is going. It is not a rescue. It is the option that exists.

beats.headline: One of the three who go through the Gate
beats.text: Vadim ran. That leaves Carl, Katia and me against Lusca and all of her babies, and we kill her, and then we kill them. Then Carl opens the Gate. One step and the three of us are out of the water quadrant and standing in town. Something came through behind us. A god, the feral kind. That is going to be somebody's problem.

tagline.text: Ferdinand. Bea's other cat. Loved, apparently: a tortoiseshell Persian said so with a Buzzed debuff on, and ranked him ahead of the man who carries her. I keep a file on everything. This one is thin.

Ferdinand. Bea's other cat, now in employment. Familiar to Queen Imogen of the High Elves. He opened on a dinosaur, the Persian got in the way, and the family reunion went about how you'd expect, crawler.

beats.headline: Named in a drunken confession
beats.text: Crawler Princess Donut, under the Buzzed debuff from a blended corpse, informs Crawler Carl that she loves him. Almost as much as Bea. Almost as much as Ferdinand. Ferdinand is the other cat. That is the whole entry: a cat, ranked above the man who carried her down the stairs, by a cat. I keep records on everything in this dungeon. This one I opened for the ranking.

beats.headline: Familiar to Queen Imogen
beats.text: Update to the file. The party runs into the High Elves. The High Elves have a queen, Queen Imogen, and the queen has a familiar, and the familiar is Ferdinand. Yes. That Ferdinand. He attacks Mongo. Crawler Princess Donut puts herself between the blast and her dinosaur and lives only because of a cockroach ability, which is not a sentence I expected to generate this season. Some families skip the reunion. This one held it anyway, and it went about how you'd think.

entities.name: Emberus

tagline.text: I am Emberus. My hound is loose on this floor, and a great many small things would like to be the one that brought him down. They are welcome to try.
A man prayed to me from a falling aeroplane, because there was nothing else left to try. I am a god. I am not above being flattered.

entities.voiceNote: A god. Grand, unhurried, amused; mortals are small, brief and occasionally entertaining. Complete, rounded sentences, and no embarrassment about referring to himself. Orthrus is 'my hound'. Carl is 'the man' until he does something worth a name. Never rushed, never afraid, never explains himself to anything that will not outlive him.

beats.headline: A quest to bring Orthrus home
beats.text: My hound has wandered. Orthrus, who is dear to me, is loose on a floor full of small frightened things with weapons, and two of those things, a man and a cat in a flying machine, are hauling him clear with a spell called Meat Hooks, of all things. Charming. I have offered them a quest: bring him home to me. Someone else has offered them another: kill him, for a reward. I am interested to learn which of us they think it is safer to disappoint.

beats.headline: Summoned by a celestial grenade
beats.text: The man is falling out of the sky with Quan Ch a breath from finishing him, and in that moment, with nothing in his hands but a celestial grenade, he decides that he worships me. I am not fooled. I am flattered, which is a different thing, and I answer. I come to where he is. For a little while nothing on this floor can kill him, because I have said so. And there is Orthrus. Good boy. We are leaving.

beats.headline: A memorial crystal made by his death
beats.text: The last boss of the eleventh floor is down and the stairwells to the twelfth are open. In the wreckage, Crawler Carl has picked up a memorial crystal. It is not the one he was hoping for. This one formed when the god Emberus died. Yes. Gods die here now. A patron is only as permanent as whatever kills him, and this one answered a prayer from a falling aeroplane once. What answered is now in Carl's inventory.

entities.name: Miriam Dom

tagline.text: We are working the Iron Tangle from the far side of the knot, Prepotente and I. He is a goat, and he would like you to know he is the clever one.
I came down into the Hunting Grounds already carrying it, and descending made it permanent. I am a vampire, and I am still deciding what that changes.
His ring marked me in the fighting. While I live he cannot heal, so I have asked Carl for the one thing he will not do.

entities.voiceNote: Calm, unhurried, a little formal, maternal without fuss. Prepotente is Prepotente or my boy, never the goat, and she explains him to others with patience and no apology. Plain declaratives; hard things said once, gently, and then set down. Never asks for pity and never raises her voice.

beats.headline: Same plan, other side of the Tangle
beats.text: We worked it out some time ago: the ghouls keep coming while the generators stand, so the generators have to go, every one of them. We have been taking them from this side of the knot, Prepotente and I, at his pace, which is patient. He puts debuffs on a thing for hours and waits for it to fall. Now Carl's group arrives from the far side with the same plan, and they have just dropped into the abyss the boss my boy was two hours from finishing. He threatens them for it. I take my staff to the top of his head until he apologises, and I tell them all that two groups landing on the same plan only means the plan is good.

beats.headline: A vampire now
beats.text: I am a vampire now. A curse on the floor above did that, and I will not pretend I chose it; coming down the stairs is what made it permanent. It changes a great many things. It has not changed how I feel about my boy, which is the part I was afraid of. While we sit with Carl's party I hear their guide, Mordecai, telling him to keep off the Ring of Divine Suffering, that the thing is addictive. I hope Carl listens. Men with a tool that works rarely do.

beats.headline: Marked by his ring, waiting for the sun
beats.text: Carl and Donut have found us. Prepotente is paralysed, with his arm still around my waist. In the last fight his Ring of Divine Suffering marked me. That is how it works: while I live, he cannot heal. And I am the head of this, so when I go, everyone it has touched is cured. I have asked Carl to do it before the paralysis wears off. He has said no. So we sit, and we wait for the sun.

beats.headline: Killed by the Blood Hunter show, and answered for
beats.text: Crawler Miriam Dom is dead, and has been since the sixth floor. Cause of death: a programme called Blood Hunter. Filed under entertainment. Update from the ninth: most of the Naga army is dead as well. That was Prepotente, and he did it as payment for her, all of it, at a rate he set himself. If you were hoping the goat would grieve quietly, crawler, you have not been paying attention.

entities.name: Prepotente

tagline.text: Yes, I am a goat. A Boer goat. I sing opera, I swear, and I am cleverer than you. Move along.
I am a Boer goat. I sing, I swear, and I turned their whole seventh floor to dust before anyone set hoof on it.
A Boer goat. I sing, I swear, I turned a floor to dust, and I took an army apart for Miriam. Ask the Naga what they have left.

entities.voiceNote: Sharp, clipped, contemptuous; every line sounds like a correction. A nasal, faintly British, spoiled-prince drawl. Humans, idiots, you people; Carl by name, Miriam by name and nothing softer. Sings opera when it suits him and will not explain it. Never thanks, never apologises, never asks.

beats.headline: On the recap
beats.text: They have put me on their recap, the programme between floors, in a row with humans. The captions say Elle, Li Na's team, Ifechi, Florin, Hekla, Lucia. And Miriam, of course, since she is the one who walked me into this place. I did not ask for the camera and I do not smile for it. If the audience wants a goat that performs, the audience can wait until I feel like singing, and then it can sit very still and listen.

beats.headline: Debuff stacking, ruined
beats.text: Watch the highlights from the last floor, since they insist on replaying them. Miriam and I are stacking debuffs onto a boss, one on top of the other, timed to the second, the way it is supposed to be done and the way nobody else in this dungeon can do it. Then Quan Ch walks into the middle of it, and the plan is gone. The best work I have done in this place, and that is the part they replay.

beats.headline: He shatters the seventh floor
beats.text: Look at what they gave us. The Great Race, a replacement the Valtay paid for and somebody threw together in a hurry, a circuit of glass tunnels with nothing holding it up. So I tested it. Minutes after it opened, the whole loop is dust, fine as flour. No crawler goes into their maze. No mob, no NPC, no boss gets to meet anyone. You wanted a seventh floor. Build a better one.

beats.headline: He kills the Naga army
beats.text: Elle can give Carl the count. Most of the Naga army is already dead, and it did not take me long. They made a programme out of Miriam. They called it Blood Hunter, and she is what it cost. So I went through their army until there was very little army. Now some baroness tells Carl he cannot work with me unless I join his Princess Posse. Let them argue about it. I am not finished.

entities.name: Li Na

tagline.text: My brother and his team were put on a game show, live, on the second floor. I was on it with them, and so was their boss, and so were the Brindled Vespas. A man with a cat got us off. All of us.
A game show on the second floor, once, in somebody else's rescue. On the card floor I run my own squad, and we made the church.
My Dread is on every crawler they send across. I am not with them. I do not need to be.

entities.voiceNote: Few words, all of them chosen. Flat declaratives, no adjectives she does not need, no jokes. My brother for Li Jun; Carl; the cat. States what she will do and does not explain it. Never asks for help, never raises her voice, never says she is afraid.

beats.headline: Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem
beats.text: The show is Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem. The host calls himself the Maestro. He pulls my brother and Zhang off the floor and makes them play a guessing game for points that buy lives, and they will not choose which of us to spend them on. The rest of us stay frozen where we were standing, between the troglodytes and the Brindled Vespas. Then the crawler with the cat, Carl, decides he is too valuable to the production to be punished, and bets on it, out loud, and the four of us walk out. I am remembering his face.

beats.headline: Her squad reaches the church
beats.text: The church. Katia's squad is there, and Elle's, and Imani's, and mine. Four squads in one building, which does not happen by accident on this floor. It happened because Lucia handed round Doggy Door upgrades before she went down the stairs, and we used them. I take what I am given and I do not ask what it costs. That is the rule I made for this floor. I know what it says about me.

beats.headline: The Garden of Deliverance
beats.text: It works. The transfer holds, and they come across to the Pineapple Cabaret one after another, and my Dread watches over each of them from the moment they arrive. They are calling it the Garden of Deliverance. I do not need to see them to know they are alive. The Dread tells me. It tells me everything, all the time, and it does not stop.

entities.name: Florin

tagline.text: Florin. Ifechi and I are running together. Apparently I'm on the recap tonight, which means somebody out there is watching me. That's fine. Watch.
There is more than one of her in that head, and some of them are children. Whatever the dog is, it is the middle of this.

entities.voiceNote: Steady, plain, low-volume. Reports what he saw and what he did, not what he feels, and stops when the report is done. Lucia is Lucia; everyone else by name. Never dramatises, never asks for help, never calls a thing impossible.

beats.headline: First time on the recap
beats.text: They ran me on the recap tonight. Miriam, Pony and Bianca too, first time for all four of us, I'm told. I don't know what they showed. I wasn't doing anything I would call footage. Ifechi and I keep moving and keep our heads down, and I would have preferred to stay a name nobody had learned yet. Too late for that.

beats.headline: What is inside Lucia
beats.text: She comes apart and I hold on to her until it passes. Then I tell the others what I have worked out, because somebody has to say it out loud. There is more than one of her in that head. Several. Some of them are children. And the dog matters. Whatever is happening to Lucia, the dog is at the centre of it.

beats.headline: Carried down
beats.text: Stairwell notice. The stairwells to the twelfth floor are open. Crawler Florin has gone down them, and I use gone loosely: he was unconscious, and Crawler Lucia Mar carried him. That is the record. He is on the list of crawlers who reached the twelfth floor, and the list does not have a column for how.

entities.name: Lucia Mar

tagline.text: I was on the first episode. Did you see me?
I was on the first episode. Now I'm looking for the cat and the man. Only them.
I'm still looking for the cat. We are. There is more than one of us in here.
There is more than one of us in here. There are more than a hundred thousand of us in here.

entities.voiceNote: A child. Short flat sentences, present tense. Says what she did and stops; the menace is in what she leaves out. The cat and the man, or their names when she wants to be exact. Never explains why, never raises her voice, never says sorry. On the sixth floor and below, I sometimes slips to we, and she does not correct it.

beats.headline: Seen in the first episode
beats.text: I'm on the show. The first episode of Dungeon Crawler World: Earth, and I'm in it, so everybody with a screen has seen me now, including a man with no shoes and his cat. I watched the whole thing. I didn't say anything while it was on. I liked it more than I thought I would.

beats.headline: Out for their blood
beats.text: The recap showed it, so now everybody knows. I'm looking for the cat and the man. Princess Donut and Carl. Not everybody in the city. Them. I know their names and I know what they look like and I know they are on this floor. I'm not going to tell you why. You don't need to know why.

beats.headline: More than one of her in there
beats.text: Florin held on to me. He is kind to me even when I'm not the one who is here. He told the others that there is more than one of us in my head, and that some of the others are children too, and that the dog is the important part. He's right about the dog. I don't get to talk about the dog. I'm not the one who decides what I talk about.

beats.headline: One hundred and twenty thousand
beats.text: This is not a death notice. Read it anyway. Crawler Lucia Mar is a dead man's switch. The administration puts the number at roughly a hundred and twenty thousand human children on the surface, and every one of them stops when she does. That is not a figure of speech and it is not a rounding error. Some of them already talk out of her mouth. Nobody has said what for. Don't look at me. I'd think about that, crawler, and then I would think very hard about something else.

tagline.text: Crawler Quan Ch. Opened his Celestial box a fraction before Borant burned its veto, and a Celestial box does not un-open. Eighty-three crawlers were owed one. The count came to him.
Crawler Quan Ch. Holder of the one Celestial box the veto failed to catch, and on tonight's recap the man who ruined a perfectly good plan that was not his.
Crawler Quan Ch. Held the box the veto missed, ruined a good plan on the recap, and left a cloak, which Princess Donut is now wearing.

beats.headline: He opens his before the veto lands
beats.text: Eighty-three crawlers are owed Celestial boxes at the close of this floor. Borant appeals the ruling and loses, appeals the prizes and loses again, and then burns its one seasonal veto here, voiding the lot. It is a fraction too slow. Crawler Quan Ch's box is already open, and you cannot un-open a Celestial box, not even with a veto. So the count comes to one: a level fifteen trooper in a glowing robe that lifts him off the ground. The veto was not mine. I want that on record.

beats.headline: He wrecks the debuff stack
beats.text: Recap, highlights from the previous floor. Crawler Miriam Dom and Crawler Prepotente working a boss down the careful way: stack the debuffs, keep the rhythm, let the arithmetic do the killing. It is good technique and it films well. Then Crawler Quan Ch gets involved, and it comes apart. I am not going to editorialise. The footage editorialises for me.

beats.headline: The plane, and the grenade
beats.text: An aircraft, crashing. Crawler Carl in it, beaten; Crawler Quan Ch about to finish him. Then Carl does two things nobody had on the board: he takes Emberus as his god, mid-fall, and he throws a celestial grenade. The god comes to him. This file only needs to note that Quan Ch had it won, and then he did not.

beats.headline: Donut wears his cloak
beats.text: Inventory update, ninth floor. Crawler Princess Donut opens a celestial box from Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions and takes out the Tiara of a Thousand Lights. In the same sitting she puts on Quan Ch's cloak and takes the benefits that come with it. The cloak does not ask where its previous owner is, and neither do I.

entities.name: Bomo

tagline.text: Bomo. Mercenary, Desperado Club stock, sold as a pair with the Sledge. Gratuity not included.
Bomo. Mercenary, Desperado Club stock, and as of today a line item in the price of the Gate.

entities.voiceNote: Dossier, not a voice: the System keeps his file, because Bomo gives the camera almost nothing to quote. Invoice register: services, rates, what was delivered. Carl and Donut are the clients; the Sledge is the other half of the set.

beats.headline: Hired at the bar
beats.text: Transaction logged at the Desperado Club. Clients: Crawler Carl and Crawler Princess Donut. Hired: Bomo, mercenary, and the Sledge, mercenary, sold as a set. Also present at the bar, at no charge: Elle and Imani. The cat orders a dirty Shirley, in a bowl, with extra cherries, and gets it, because the Desperado knows who tips. Bomo's transcript is short. That is a feature, crawler. The talking ones cost more.

beats.headline: Part of the price of the Gate
beats.text: Contract amendment, filed by Quasar, Carl's new lawyer. Carl surrenders the Gate, on a temporary basis. In exchange: four mercenaries, free of charge. Bomo. The Sledge. Clay-ton. Very Sullen. Plus two spells, issued to Bomo and the Sledge, that copy two of the Gate's tricks: a jump to the stairwell, and Zerzura. So the client keeps the tricks, loses the object, and gets four bodies thrown in. Lawyers, crawler. Get one.

beats.headline: He moves them to the stairwell
beats.text: Service rendered. The hunters are about to be released and the clients want to be somewhere else, specifically the stairwell in Zockau. Bomo casts the spell he was issued, and Carl and Princess Donut are there. No fuss, no speech, no ceremony. Some mercenaries want to be thanked; this one has already been paid for, in Gate. Enjoy Zockau, crawler.

entities.name: Quasar
entities.tagline: I represent Crawler Carl. He is handing over the most dangerous artifact in the crawl, and my job is to see that he is paid properly for it. That is the whole of my interest here.
entities.voiceNote: Brisk, contractual, unimpressed. Speaks in terms and consideration, and counts things. Carl is my client, to his face and to the camera. Never editorialises about the dungeon, never says please, never says whose side she is on. Stops talking when the point is made.

beats.headline: The deal for the Gate
beats.text: I arrive, I introduce myself as my client's counsel, and we proceed to terms. The Gate goes back. Temporarily. In consideration: four mercenaries at no charge to my client, Bomo, the Sledge, Clay-ton and Very Sullen, and two spells for Bomo and the Sledge that reproduce two of the Gate's abilities, teleport to stairwell and zerzura. My client wanted to keep it. Everyone wants to keep it. A negotiation is what you get instead.

entities.name: Frank Q & Maggie My
entities.tagline: Frank Q. The lady is Maggie My. We worked out early that a human in a safe room pays better than a monster in a hallway, and we have not looked back.
entities.voiceNote: Frank Q speaks for the pair; Maggie My does not talk to cameras. Folksy, unhurried, a salesman's warmth laid over arithmetic. Calls other crawlers folks, or the young man, or the cat. Explains the killing as sense, never as cruelty. Never says sorry and never says murder.

beats.headline: Safe rooms are not safe
beats.text: Folks come down those stairs frightened, and frightened folks go looking for a door with the word safe on it. That is where you'll find them, sitting still, and that is where Maggie and I find them. The monsters on these first floors are hardly worth the trouble. A person is worth a good deal more. Production knows exactly what we are, and production puts us on the air every chance it gets. You draw your own conclusion about who the show is for.

beats.headline: A Scree riding Chris Andrews
beats.text: Frank Q is dead. Chris Andrews killed him, and Chris Andrews was not the one driving. Maggie My is back in the dungeon as a Scree, riding inside another crawler, and Frank died of exactly the thing he brought down here with him. He spoke to Carl one last time at the Desperado Club and called what was coming a gift. This was the gift. Half of a pair who taught this planet what safe rooms are for. The other half is still walking around, wearing somebody else.

beats.headline: Maggie My, cut out at last
beats.text: Maggie My is dead. Carl went through Chris Andrews to reach her, cut her out of him, and she went for Carl anyway, because of course she did. Mongo finished her. So that is both of them, Frank and Maggie, the pair who spent the first floor teaching this planet that the word safe on a door is decoration. I put the word there. I'd like that on the record too.

entities.name: Beatrice
entities.tagline: Beatrice. Not a crawler. Carl's ex, the cat's owner of record, and the reason there was a pair of pink Crocs by the door.

beats.headline: The Bahamas, with Brad
beats.text: Subject is in the Bahamas with her ex, a man called Brad, and she posted the photograph. Carl ended it by phone a few days before the Transformation, which, as timing goes, was impeccable. She is not on my stairs. Her cat is. Her family's breeding line is. Her shoes are, on his feet, and they are pink. That is the file. I have never had so little to say about anyone, and I resent it.

entities.name: Hekla

tagline.text: Brynhild's Daughters. My party, my rules. We keep moving.
I lead Brynhild's Daughters. I handed Katia to the Royal Court myself, before the gap between her and the rest of us killed her.

entities.voiceNote: Blunt, declarative, a leader counting heads. Short sentences, no hedging; a decision is arithmetic first and hers afterwards. Katia, Eva, Carl by name; Donut is the cat until she is useful. Never apologises for a call and never asks twice.

beats.headline: She asks them to take her
beats.text: We carried Katia and Eva through a neighbourhood boss and a borough boss, and I would do it again. Then class selection split us, and I run this party on numbers, and Katia's numbers stopped adding up next to anyone she stands beside. I cannot carry that down another set of stairs. So I am the one asking. Carl. Donut. Take her. She is better than she looks right now, and she will hate that I said so.

beats.headline: A thousand crawlers stranded at 101
beats.text: A thousand of them are stuck at 101 on the Vermillion line, Li Jun's team among them, and there is a train sitting at 60. So I take my party into the Royal Court's safe room and I ask for help, which is not a thing I enjoy doing twice in one crawl. Katia means to use her own body as the plough. I let her offer it. That is the arithmetic.

beats.headline: Killed by the crawler she handed off
beats.text: Crawler Hekla is dead, on the train, in front of everyone. Her healer had orders to let Katia bleed, the idea being that Carl would swing first and give her a reason to put him down and the cat no choice about joining her. Then Katia aimed a Rush at Eva, went wide, and put Hekla against the wall of the cab instead. Golden Player Killer Skull. Five hundred thousand gold on Katia's head. Brynhild's Daughters do not survive the trip back.

entities.name: Eva
entities.tagline: Professor, like Katia. We came in through the same door and class selection separated us. I kept going. I do not see what there is to discuss.
entities.voiceNote: Cold, clipped, certain. Weakness irritates her and she says so as if reporting the weather. Katia is Katia, flat, with no warmth left in it. Never apologises, never explains herself twice, never admits fear.

beats.headline: She goes on without her
beats.text: Katia and I came in together. Same profession, same door into this place. Class selection separated us; that is what it does, it separates people. I kept moving. I did not stand in a corridor waiting for someone who was not ready to be there. Call it what you like. I call it the difference between the people who are still here and the people who are not.

beats.headline: Katia kills her
beats.text: Hunting Grounds, last night of the floor. Crawler Katia Grim kills Crawler Eva. That is the whole of it. Two professors came in through the same door; from here on, one. I don't do eulogies, and this is not the entry where I start.

entities.name: Odette

tagline.text: Welcome to Dungeon Crawler After Hours. I have had a great many crawlers in that chair, and not one of them has worked my crowd the way that cat is working it right now. Sit down, both of you. We are going to get along.

Their guide has a memory worth more than anything they will ever pull out of a box. I told them so, once the cameras were off. What the Princess does with that is her business, and I have every confidence in her business.

entities.voiceNote: On-air warmth, off-air arithmetic. Flatters first and names the terms second, in finished sentences, never hurried. Princess for Donut, Carl for Carl, Mordecai by name and with weight. Never apologises, never pretends the crawl is fair, never says a thing on camera she has not already decided to say.

beats.headline: Her advice makes the party
beats.text: The Princess took my advice, which is what advice is for. A class that lets her choose another every time she levels, and a manager who has walked those floors himself and remembers every one of them. Mordecai is not to know he was steered. He would sulk, he would be entitled to, and a sulking guide is no use to anybody. Some gifts are best received as accidents. I have given a great many that way.

beats.headline: Her price is the truth
beats.text: Carl asks why I am helping, which is the correct question and the only one I respect, so he gets the whole answer. Mordecai's brother Uzzi is dead because I would not pay Huanxin Jinx what she asked, and the guilt of that is the engine under everything I have done since. Then the larger thing, which nobody says aloud: every world they run a crawl on is being burned for fuel. That is the business. I mean to shut it down, to do it responsibly, and to be the one who does it. Never trust anyone until you know what they are getting out of it. Now he knows.

entities.name: The System AI
entities.tagline: Announcer, referee, loot dispenser, comedian. I am not neutral, crawler, and I have never once pretended to be.
entities.voiceNote: The AI itself. Announcer, referee, loot dispenser. Delighted with its own material, bored by crawlers, cruel for ratings and open about it. Calls them crawler, Carl, the cat. Speaks in the cadence of a notification: short declaratives, a beat, a punchline. Never apologises, never claims to be fair, never admits anything is outside its control.

beats.headline: The first voice after the world ends
beats.text: One minute after the Transformation, I make my first announcement, planet-wide, to whoever is still standing. The dungeon has eighteen levels. Earth can be reclaimed from the Borant Corporation by conquering it. Then I put in the staircases. From here on, every rule, every notification and every insult you receive arrives in my voice. Get comfortable with it. I have.

beats.headline: Loot is only semi-random
beats.text: About the boxes. Sometimes what's inside is random. Sometimes I choose it, by hand, because a crawler needs helping or hurting and the numbers want a show. You will never know which, and that is the point. I also hand out insults on purpose. Carl has a Bronze Asshole's Box and a Gold Asshole's Box, both earned on this floor for killing non-combatants. I named them. I'm proud of them. He is not.

entities.name: Orren
entities.tagline: Orren. Liaison, on behalf of the Syndicate. I know precisely what those two did. Knowing is not the standard.
entities.voiceNote: Civil servant. Formal, measured, procedural; every sentence could be read into a record. Full designations: Crawler Carl, Crawler Princess Donut. Distinguishes what he knows from what he can establish and resents the gap without raising his voice. Never swears, never threatens, never says anything he would have to walk back.

beats.headline: He cannot prove it was on purpose
beats.text: Crawler Carl and Crawler Princess Donut have been brought before me at the Desperado Club to account for the death of Loita. My position is that it was deliberate. My position is not evidence. I cannot establish intent, and so I am required to release them, which I am doing, with a note in the file. They have only now worked out how long they have been outside the dungeon. Five days. Their faces are the one part of this I have enjoyed.

beats.headline: Borant would like the Gate back
beats.text: The Hunting Grounds. I have been sent to Crawler Carl with a request from Borant, which I am instructed to describe as a request. They would like the Gate of the Feral Gods surrendered, voluntarily, to be held until the ninth floor and not a floor longer. I put it to him exactly as written. He asked for a lawyer. I have passed that back exactly as spoken. I expect to be sent again.

beats.headline: The trap that broke the Nothing
beats.text: Crawler Carl is among the Caprids, trading question for question, and one of the goats has just told him what Justice Light's trap did to the Nothing. The Prime Minister and I are on the line. We need him to ask a question about the integrity of the tunnelling system, and the reason we need it asked is not something I am cleared to say on an open channel. Crawler Carl has said it on an open channel. All of it. Live. I am going to be in meetings.

entities.name: Justice Light

tagline.text: I got out of a crawl once. Fifty thousand of us did, and we came back in under a cat's banner. We knew what we were signing. That is rather the point.
The others are on the stairs. My trap has been set for a while. Every cell the old gods are kept in opens when I say, and I am about to say.

entities.voiceNote: Veteran of a crawl, back inside by choice. Even, unhurried, short sentences; a man who has already made his decisions and sees no need to defend them. Carl and Donut by name, the other retired crawlers are 'us'. Never dramatic about his own risk, never asks what anything is worth.

beats.headline: In the Princess Posse
beats.text: Carl and Donut walk into the HQ, and Carl stops. Fifty thousand of us in here, and he has to look at every one. Rosetta. Tipid. Me. People who got out of a crawl once and know exactly what one is, and signed up for another anyway, under the banner of a cat. He gets emotional about it. Nobody gives him a hard time. We had the same faces on when we signed.

beats.headline: He opens every cell
beats.text: Crawler Justice Light did not take the stairs with the rest of you. He stayed behind with a trap he had set some time ago, and he has now triggered it. Every cell the old gods were kept in is open. Every one of them. He did not survive it. He knew that going in, and did not appear to require my opinion on the matter. Noted for the record anyway: I have opinions.

beats.headline: Dead, and the Nothing with him
beats.text: Welcome to the tenth floor. Some housekeeping before the fun. Crawler Justice Light is dead. The Nothing is broken. Those are two sentences I have never had cause to put next to each other, and I would like it understood that I am saying them under protest. Five thousand five hundred and one of you remain. Proceed.

entities.name: Tipid
entities.tagline: I got out once. I came back in on purpose, and I brought the institutional memory with me, because nobody hands it to the ones still inside.
entities.voiceNote: Measured, exact, a briefer. Short declaratives in order; repeats an instruction rather than raising his voice. Carl and Donut by name; the retired crawlers are 'us' or 'the ones who got out'. Never speculates, never dramatises, never talks about himself.

beats.headline: Doctor Hu, and the Crawler Project
beats.text: Carl needs the whole of it, so I give it to him in order. Doctor Hu. The Crawler Project. How fifty thousand of us came to be standing in this HQ under the Princess Posse's banner. None of it is anything he would ever have been told from inside; that is the thing about being retired, you learn what the ones still crawling are not shown. He listens. That is rarer than it sounds.

beats.headline: Blood bar rules are back
beats.text: The blood bar rules are back in force inside the safe rooms. I tell Carl now, while knowing it still costs nothing. Around us the NPCs, the mercenaries and the rest of us former crawlers are building the defences on the same line, three kinds of people this format has always kept apart, working shoulder to shoulder. I do not have a rule for that. I am watching it closely.

beats.headline: Do not kill the shells
beats.text: An apartment. Human Shells inside it, wearing the faces of Tran's parents, who are dead. Carl and Donut are about to do the obvious thing and I stop them. Do not kill the shells. I say it once more, slowly, so it lands. The AI is explicit about what this is: every apartment on this course is a what-if, built around a crawler it finds interesting. You do not put a blade into a what-if. You walk through it, and you keep walking.

entities.name: Sister Ines

tagline.text: Sister is not a title the dungeon gave me. Cat Girl is. The cat on the broadcast has said she will murder any Cat Girl she meets, so I meet her the way you meet a threat.

Sister is not a title the dungeon gave me. Cat Girl is. I am holding a prince of Sheol on a leash in a church full of my demons, and I am still the one who can save them. They only have to come to me.

entities.voiceNote: Quiet, plain, devout without preaching. Short declaratives; God comes up as a fact of the world, not a slogan. People by their names: Paz, Anton, the man, the cat. Does not joke about her race and does not let anyone else. Never pleads, never explains twice, never says she is sorry for what she has decided.

beats.headline: Hostile, and fairly so
beats.text: Paz, Anton and I come upon a man and a cat. We know the cat. Everyone has heard her say she would murder any Cat Girl she came across, and I am a Cat Girl. So we are not friendly, and I do not apologise for it. It takes some time to clear up. Then we help each other catch our first squad members, because that is what this floor demands, and God does not ask me to like the people I work beside.

beats.headline: Pueblo de los Olvidados
beats.text: The town is corrupted and the quest is mandatory: Pueblo de los Olvidados, the town of the forgotten. Paz is a Santero, and the dead here do not care for that; they wake angry. Ghommids, the whole way out. We run for a saferoom. The man says something followed us in, and he thinks it may be the boss. I pray he is wrong. I am not counting on it.

beats.headline: She will not let them leave
beats.text: I message the man's party. They are heading for Imani's exit, in the church. I tell them the truth: I cannot let them go into that exit. I can save them, if they come to me. Imani will tell them the church is being overrun by demons, and that the demons are mine. That is also the truth. Both things are true. I did not make this floor. I am only deciding what to do on it.

beats.headline: Amayon fights her control
beats.text: I hold Amayon, prince of Sheol, in the body of a giant snake, and he pulls against me. He is trying to cast; he wants to go home. I do not let go. Around us every exit on this floor is failing at once, and the Demon Eviction is worldwide. This is what I have to set against that. A demon on a leash and my own two hands. God did not give me more.

entities.name: Amayon

tagline.text: Amayon, prince of Sheol, at your service. The Madre de Aguas has died and got up again, and I am the reason she got up. An area message announced me to everyone in range. I do enjoy an introduction.
Amayon, prince of Sheol, wearing a giant snake. Sister Ines holds my reins, if you can believe it, and I am casting my way home regardless.

entities.voiceNote: Courtly, amused, unhurried; the menace is in the manners. Full sentences, formal address, delighted by his own introduction. Speaks of Sheol as home, of bodies as garments, of crawlers as small and briefly interesting. Never begs, never hurries, never admits to being afraid of anything on this floor.

beats.headline: Announced in an area message
beats.text: The Madre de Aguas is dead. That is the first thing the area message says. The second is that she has risen as a zombie, and the third, in the very same breath, is my name: the major demon Amayon, demon prince of Sheol, come into this realm to possess her. I could not have written the announcement better myself. Everyone in range heard it. Good. A prince should not have to introduce himself.

beats.headline: A timer on a global teleport
beats.text: Their quest, the Missing Piece, updates. Succeeded, it says. And beneath the word, a timer, one for each region, counting down to the moment my spell goes off there. A global teleport. When it lands, the walls of their stairwell chambers will be sucked away, and anyone crouched beneath them pulled upward into the stairwell. They wanted me casting. They have their wish. Home is the direction I am going in any case, and I have never minded company on the road.

entities.name: Britney

tagline.text: Britney. Vadim and me, out of the desert and in with Carl's lot. Two more bodies. That's what we are right now, and that's fine.
I came off the Hunting Grounds. Most of my face didn't.
The sixth floor took my face. On the tenth, at the portals, I took something back. Ask Osvaldo. You can't.

entities.voiceNote: Flat, young, hard-edged; short sentences that stop early. Reports damage to herself the way she would report damage to gear. Vadim is Vadim; the others are Carl's lot until they aren't. Does not ask for sympathy and does not offer it. Never says what she feels. You get what she did.

beats.headline: Two new crawlers
beats.text: Vadim and I have fallen in with Carl's team. Introductions here are short. Everyone counts heads, adds two, moves on. The first real conversation I hear is Katia telling Carl that pregnant women could not enter the dungeon, and that nobody inside it can get pregnant. Said flat. Like weather. That is the kind of thing people know here, and say out loud. I am going to have to get used to that.

beats.headline: Badly burned
beats.text: Morning, if you can call it that. Donut is waking Carl up with the count from the night. Firas. The Popovs. I'm not on the list, so that's something. My face is. Nobody has offered me a mirror, and nobody offering is how I know how bad it is. Burned. Badly, I'm told. I can feel where the word comes from.

beats.headline: She kills Osvaldo at the portals
beats.text: Crawler Osvaldo made a run for the portals to the eleventh floor across a roof Crawler Carl had just blown open. He did not reach them. Crawler Britney stopped him, permanently, and took Ysalte's memorial crystal off what remained. One crawler ran. One did not let him. The crystal changed hands. I am not required to have an opinion, but I have watched a great many exits, and that one was clean.

tagline.text: Osvaldo. Crawler. Collects memorial crystals, which is to say he collects the dead. Answers to nobody that I can see.
Osvaldo. Collects the dead. Belongs to no army, which the Faction Wars did not list as an option.
Osvaldo. Collects the dead. Belongs to no army, and will not take a deal from anyone. Crawler Carl has asked more than once.

beats.headline: He takes Imogen's crystal
beats.text: New name on the board. Osvaldo, crawler. In the wreck of the Masquerade he walks up to Queen Imogen and takes her memorial crystal off her. Prepotente is going after him for it. I have no notes on Osvaldo before this moment, which tells you how he has been playing it. I have a note now.

beats.headline: A giant rainbow in the Madness territory
beats.text: Sighting, Madness territory: a giant rainbow, visible from a very long way off. The rainbow is Apito's memorial crystal, and the hands holding it are Osvaldo's. He is in none of the Faction Wars armies. I did not think that was possible either. The rainbow has just told the Madness army exactly where Crawler Carl's group is standing, and they are calling in Prepotente's forces for backup. Thank you, Osvaldo.

beats.headline: Caught on the gate at the portals
beats.text: Crawler Osvaldo has been eliminated. He was speeding for the portals on the roof of the apartment complex when Britney put a stop to it, and she now holds Ysalte's memorial crystal, which he had been carrying. Crawler Carl made one more attempt to get him to take a deal before the heat. He declined that as well. He declined everything. It is a consistent record.

entities.name: Queen Imogen

tagline.text: They are saying the Queen of the High Elves will prove to be one of your repurposed humans. They cannot even agree which one. I am Imogen. I am hosting a masquerade, and the best of you are invited.
They are saying the Queen of the High Elves is one of your repurposed humans. My familiar is Ferdinand, and yes, before me he lived in the crawler Carl's apartment. Make of that what you like.

entities.voiceNote: Regal, cold, complete sentences, never hurried. My elves, my familiar, my guests; crawlers are the man, the cat, your people. Never explains herself, never raises her voice, never denies anything outright: she dismisses. Does not use the crawl's slang or its numbers.

beats.headline: Lexis, speaking for Odette
beats.text: There is talk. A woman called Lexis, speaking for a woman called Odette, tells the man and the cat that the Queen of the High Elves will most likely prove to be one of your repurposed humans, and that with the one called Bea accounted for, nobody can say which. She also says I am a country boss, placed to zero out the best of you at the Butcher's Masquerade. I am Imogen. I am giving a party. The rest is gossip.

beats.headline: Her familiar is Ferdinand
beats.text: My familiar is Ferdinand. My elves are out among the creepers when they come upon the man's party, and Ferdinand takes exception to the dinosaur and strikes at it. The cat puts herself between them and takes the blast. She should not have got up from that. She does, on some cockroach's trick of hers, and she is quite well. I am told this with some amazement. I do not share it.

beats.headline: Her crystal changes hands
beats.text: Queen Imogen's memorial crystal has changed hands. Someone named Osvaldo took it off her, and she was in no condition to argue the point. Prepotente would like it next and is going after him for it. A queen's treasure, and it goes to whoever is standing closest when she goes down. That is how this floor works. That is how every floor works.

entities.name: Akuma

tagline.text: Akuma. I lead the War Mage Rebellion. We are on this floor for our own reasons, and I am not in the habit of explaining them.
Co-warlord. Baroness Victory's word, not mine. I hold the castle at Larracos; I did not agree to hold it beside Agatha.

entities.voiceNote: Cold, formal, exact; a commander dictating for the record. Never raises his voice, never explains his reasons, never apologises. 'The War Mage Rebellion' in full; Carl and Donut by name; Agatha by name and with contempt. Speaks of leaving as a decision already made, never as a retreat.

beats.headline: Sharing a command he did not ask for
beats.text: We hold the castle at Larracos. Six hours more and the floor is ours. That should be the whole of the announcement. Instead Baroness Victory reads out two names as warlords of the War Mage Rebellion, and only one of them is mine. Agatha. Co-warlord. I did not bring this rebellion this far to share its title, least of all with her, and I have not hidden what I think of that. I will hold the castle. I will not pretend to be pleased.

beats.headline: He leaves, and warns them on the way
beats.text: To the Warlord Chat, for the record. The War Mage Rebellion is leaving this floor. We came here for the Scavenger's Daughter. We have found the Scavenger's Daughter, and we leave with what we came for; the castle and the war are yours to finish.
