She said at the finish that everything she did she did for her people; he told her to her face that she did it for herself and that her people will pay for it. I am obliged to broadcast both halves of an exchange like that.

relations.note: Sold on to Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions.
The sponsor slot she sold is the one the tiara comes out of.

entities.name: Cascadia

tagline.text: You have been hearing me since the first floor. Now get out there and kill, kill, kill. Yes. That voice. It is mine, and so is the show.
There is tequila going through the rebreather. I have run out of the face I put on for the microphone.
I asked it to let me die. It said no, and it took my flippers off with the loudspeaker open. Say the line, Cascadia. Say the line.

entities.voiceNote: Two registers with no bridge between them. On air she is bright and condescending, calls the crawlers monkeys and twits, and signs off with the same three words every time. Off air she is exhausted, profane about her own production, and wildly self-pitying about the floor she designed. Says 'the production', 'the network', 'my floor'. Never apologises.

beats.headline: The card system, explained brightly
beats.text: Good morning, crawlers. Today I walk you through the card system, and I do it in the voice, because the voice is the thing you people respond to. Somebody upstairs decided this floor gets decks and totems and a duelling format. Somebody upstairs is always deciding. Now get out there and kill, kill, kill.

beats.headline: One crisis shy of the failsafe
beats.text: They put the ninth floor's planning meeting in front of me, and the crawler asks after an administrator who has recently stopped attending meetings. So I come through in person, rebreather and all, two feet of me, and I raise my little arms and invite him to try something, because whatever he does to me happens to him as well. I tell the room I am one crisis away from pulling the thing that finishes all of us. The cat suggests moisturiser and cucumber slices and refers to me throughout as Zev's boss.

beats.headline: Coming apart at the warlord council
beats.text: I get through the official business. Mostly. The words are not arriving in the order I put them in, and every warlord on the call is watching me not arrange them. Princess Vinata uses my family out loud today, to unsettle a crawler, as though my family were a piece of set dressing she is permitted to move. I let her. There is nothing in what she says that I can dispute.

beats.headline: The catchphrase, and what it costs to refuse it
beats.text: It wants the line. I will not give it the line. So I ask it, over the loudspeaker, with the whole floor listening, why it will not simply let me die, and it takes several of my flippers off me for asking. I am the executive producer of this season. I designed a floor. Somebody write that down.

beats.headline: An announcement, mostly about her ex-husband
beats.text: The announcement is meant to cover the outreach guild between the next two races, and the rule that the seventh race runs three teams to a heat with one team walking out of it. I get all of that out. I also get out a great deal about my ex-husband, because the microphone was already open and nobody in this building has the standing to take it off me.

relations.note: Zev answers to her.

entities.name: Asojano
entities.tagline: A god nobody has worshipped in a very long time, standing in a town he used to rule. Level 130, non-corporeal, and wearing a hat that stops him seeing where he is going.

description.text: Asojano - Orisha. Level 130 City Boss. This is a non-corporeal spirit. Also known as the Lord of Smallpox, Asojano is one of the most respected and feared of the Orishas, a former god made flesh upon the rise of the Ascendency. As the worshippers of these gods grew more and more extinct, their temples crumbled, and the power of these former deities waned. […] One day, not so long ago, Asojano found himself here in this small town, visiting the world he once helped rule. There was no malice to his actions. He came just so he could look upon what he once had and what he had lost. Still, power lingers, even in the most forgotten of shells. Asojano is disease incarnate. He kills, and he heals. He is life, and he is death. He also wears a reed hat that makes it difficult to see where he's going, so he bumps into stuff a lot.

beats.headline: A city boss attaches himself to the party
beats.text: I have him at level 130 and non-corporeal, and he is now walking along with a crawler party as though that were a normal thing for a city boss to do. There is a request attached to the company: repair his shrine and the spirits held in this town go free. He asks Paz specifically, which tells you he has read the party's paperwork rather more carefully than the party has.

beats.headline: The ritual at the shrine
beats.text: They reach the temple intact. Carl flags a ghommid splitter by the name of Skylar Spinach on the way, which I enjoyed. Asojano begins his ritual, and at that exact moment Ogun hands his own worshippers a quest of his own: one shrine may be repaired, and he would like it to be his. Paz and Anton read it together. Carl, Donut and Ines start working out how one fights a city boss inside his own temple.

beats.headline: Flagged a heartbeat before he falls
beats.text: Deities arrive from every direction, each with a shrine to argue for. Carl sends Bomo to repair Yemaya's, which settles the argument. Donut, Mongo and Bomo take Asojano apart, and Carl flags him a heartbeat before he goes, so what remains of the Lord of Smallpox is a card in a crawler's deck. The ghommid settlement is liberated. Carl leaves with slugpox, which is very much the sort of souvenir this floor hands out.

beats.headline: Half of Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang
beats.text: The card gets played. Asojano and Uzi Jesus combine into a single totem, Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang, which is either the best or the worst thing to happen to a former god of disease. I have decided not to rule on which.

relations.note: Into the deck.

entities.name: Rishi

tagline.text: I speak for the Blood Sultanate at these meetings. Not royalty, whatever the cat has assumed. A cousin. By marriage.
My arms are off and I am sitting in a crawler's safe room, and I am still the only one in it holding a document worth signing.

entities.voiceNote: A diplomat's register: the clause first, the threat second, and 'harshly' where another speaker would say what he means. Calls Carl 'crawler' and Donut 'Your Highness', with no warmth in either. Discusses his own survival as though it were policy. Never once says what he wants for himself.

beats.headline: A compromise, with a warning attached
beats.text: The crawler tables an action item on Juice Box's behalf: a tenth team drawn from the NPCs, holding the same protections the rest of us hold. My position is a compromise. Give them the protections. That is reasonable and it costs this room nothing. But should Juice Box's attacks continue, the Sultanate will be obliged to respond harshly, and I would like the minutes to show that I said so here, first, and calmly.

beats.headline: The Great Consensus, and a fleet
beats.text: They have me, so they may have the rest of it. The philosophy is called the Great Consensus, and Vinata was an adherent of it, and what her circle intended was to take the Naga fleet and quit the central system entirely. I did not walk into that temple beside my wife. I knew what was waiting inside it, and I knew that going in with her made me as dead as she is. So I stayed outside, and buried myself in the dirt, and here I am, with something to trade.

beats.headline: The offer, and the ring
beats.text: For the record: the prisoner offered Crawler Carl a signed instrument granting every native of Earth citizenship in Naga lands, in exchange for the Naga settling the other planets of Earth's system. A real document, and worth something. Crawler Carl marked him with the Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering. Then he killed him. Sultan Rishi the Usurper, first of his name of the Naga Uprising, is dead.

beats.headline: His belongings arrive in the safe room
beats.text: Housekeeping. Crawler Carl opened a fan box and the entire contents of the late Sultan's inventory landed in the middle of the safe room. Among it: makeup samples for a merchandise line built around Princess Donut, which Princess Donut had not approved, and about which she has a very great deal to say. The gremlins carried on with the repairs throughout.

entities.name: Damascus Steel

tagline.text: Assistant lead at the Penis Parade, and the one who can get you through the door you are actually looking for. Look at your elbow, crawler. Now look at mine.
My mother is dead and my father ordered it. I am not asking you for help. I am telling you to put every dancer in this club on a mercenary contract before I go.

entities.voiceNote: Low, flat and transactional, with a bouncer's economy of words. Calls Carl 'crawler' and the customers nothing at all. Warm only about the dancers and his family, and he explains neither. Gives instructions rather than making requests, and expects them followed.

beats.headline: The door behind the club
beats.text: He comes in asking for a way into the Guild of Suffering, which is not a thing anyone asks a dancer, and he has the spiderweb on his elbow that says he is entitled to ask it. So I take him to a private cubicle, and out the back of the cubicle, to the entrance nobody advertises. On his way out I tell him to limp. Let the room think he paid for what he actually got.

beats.headline: Two brothers on the floor of their own club
beats.text: Carl and Samantha come through the club with the Vorpals still working behind them, and what they find is me and Anaconda flat on the floor, crying, in front of the whole room. The Vorpals take Minge in the same minute. I do not care what any of them see. My mother is dead.

beats.headline: What the family actually is
beats.text: So the crawler gets all of it. My mother and the Night Wyrm were crawlers themselves, a long time ago, and they are our parents, mine and Anaconda's. She spent years pulling strings so the two of us would be dancers rather than something worse, and those strings are gone now. Hire every dancer out of the Penis Parade as mercenaries. All of them. Today. Then they keep breathing. My brother and I have somewhere else to be, and it is wherever our father is.

entities.name: Anaconda
entities.tagline: Level 75, quarter naga, lead dancer of the club's ground floor and the cat's declared favourite of the entire roster. Currently face down on his own workplace floor, weeping, which is not in the routine.

beats.headline: Crying in the middle of a raid
beats.text: Level 75. Quarter naga. Lead dancer at the Penis Parade and Princess Donut's declared favourite of the whole roster, a preference she has shared with the audience more than once. Carl and Samantha come in off the street with the Vorpals still at work, and there he is beside Damascus Steel, crying too hard to stand up. The Vorpals take Minge in front of him. He does not look up for it.

beats.headline: Family business
beats.text: Another of the dancers offers to come along and fight. He declines, and the reason he gives is family business, which is the first time anybody in that club has said the word family out loud in front of a crawler. Damascus hauls him up off the floor. He says that if his brother is going after their father then he is going too, and the pair of them walk into the back cubicles, where whatever happens happens off camera.

entities.name: Baroness Victory

tagline.text: Orc. Attorney. Adjutant. I put my own aunt into indentureship over unpaid taxes, and the other parties still had to sue to try to keep me out of this game. The filing was badly drafted.
An Elite walked into the fortress carrying somebody else's sponsorship and a great deal of explosive. He did not reach the second room.
Two names hold the castle at Larracos and only one of them wanted a colleague. I read them out as written.

entities.voiceNote: An attorney first and an officer second: the rule, then the consequence, then silence. Formal address for Carl and Donut, none for anybody else. Fond of a loophole and entirely unembarrassed by her own family. Never threatens, on the grounds that a threat is merely a badly drafted notice.

beats.headline: Three candidates, and the crawler picks the lawyer
beats.text: Odette puts three of us in front of the crawlers on her show, having first announced that she is sponsoring a deity of her own this season, Nekhebit, which is her affair. What the crawlers are choosing is an adjutant for the ninth floor. Carl picks me. He does not ask what I did for a living before this, which is just as well, because the answer is tax work, and the answer after that is that I did it to my own relatives.

beats.headline: Herman the Fleet does not get to finish
beats.text: Carl, Donut, Tipid and Florin come into the Fortress of Unyielding Power and Authority, and Florin walks them through the ceasefire rules. Then an Elite by the name of Herman the Fleet, sent in by Sensation Entertainment, reveals what he actually is, which is a delivery system for a bomb. I deal with him. An adjutant may do that. It is in the rules, and I have read the rules.

beats.headline: The rules of the parlay
beats.text: I walk Carl and Donut up to the parlay and give them the rules before we arrive, because a parlay is a contract with a shorter fuse than most. King Rust brings Deng Bao, a Grixist, as his adjutant. Donut notices before I do that King Rust is crying.

beats.headline: A ruling about the goat
beats.text: Most of the Naga army is already dead and Prepotente did it, for what the Blood Hunter show did to Miriam Dom. Carl would like to work with him. My advice is a ruling rather than an opinion: he may not, not directly, not while Prepotente stands outside the Princess Posse. Bring the goat inside the team, or keep your distance from him.

beats.headline: Two warlords for one rebellion
beats.text: The War Mage Rebellion holds the castle at Larracos, and six hours on the clock decides the floor. I read the adjudication out exactly as it is written: Akuma and Agatha, co-warlords, equal standing. One of those two is displeased and does not trouble to conceal it.

entities.name: Vinata

tagline.text: Princess of the Naga and warlord of the Blood Sultanate. For these games you are welcome to call me the Whore. It saves everybody a great deal of time.
My house has never once had to finish one of these wars. There is a door out of every castle, and a god standing at the far end of ours.
There is a crawler in my god's temple, and he came through a door I built for myself. Good. Let him stand where a god can see him.

entities.voiceNote: Silk, and delivered very close to the ear. Prefers a question to a statement and a whisper to a speech. Calls Carl 'the crawler' and never by name; calls her house 'the Sultanate' and never 'us'. Offers other people their own dead as though it were a courtesy. Never says what the Naga are actually doing.

beats.headline: A whisper at the warlord council
beats.text: I come and stand at the crawler's shoulder while the council goes on around us, and I put a small question to him quietly, so that he alone hears it. Cascadia's whole family is dead. How does he imagine he will manage when his own is? He gives me no answer at all. That is an answer.

beats.headline: The door into Club Vanquisher
beats.text: The Sultanate's trick is older than this season of theirs. One of the warlord's guards worships a god of light; the god summons its worshipper to a temple inside Club Vanquisher; the warlord's party travels with her, out of a castle nobody has ever cracked. This season I take the worship myself, and my god is Khepri, the usual name on that list having been bought out by the Open Intellect Pacifist Action Network. Rosetta has been reading old seasons, and she has the shape of it.

beats.headline: The trap has two immortals inside it
beats.text: They come through the portal into Khepri's temple, the crawler and Katia and the goat, with Samantha opening the door for them. Standing this near a god hands out ninety seconds of immortality and it does not enquire whose side anybody is on. His patch gives him his ninety. Being what I am gives me mine.

beats.headline: Ninety seconds each, and hers runs out first
beats.text: Warlord Vinata of the Blood Sultanate is dead. Crawler Carl set a bomb down inside the temple and stood in the middle of it, and everything in that room without a god's blessing went with the blast. Two of them had one. The crawler and the warlord came out through the doorway wrapped around each other, and while they were still on the ground his slugpox returned to him, and a slug reached her in the second her ninety were spent. The portal is open. There are gods walking out of it into Club Vanquisher.

relations.note: The crown's outstanding requirement is paid in her nagas.

entities.name: Dong Quixote

tagline.text: Seventy years of age, a lance built for a mounted man, and at long last a mount to put beneath it. I dance for my living. I adventured for it first.
Mr. Jefferson has left me, and he has taken something of mine along with him. Corcunda is behind a garage door I am not permitted to open.
A war god is coming for the most beautiful man who has ever lived. He shall have to come through the lance. Vale to you all. Vale.

entities.voiceNote: Chivalric and entirely sincere about it: formal address, archaic flourishes, and 'Mr. Jefferson' for a tube sock full of nickels. Calls Corcunda the most beautiful man who has ever lived and will say it to anybody. Seventy years old, an adventurer before he was a dancer, and unembarrassed by either trade. Says 'Vale' where another man would say goodbye.

beats.headline: A mercenary with a lance and a sock
beats.text: I present myself at the Madness headquarters alongside Katia, Imani, Splash Zone and Bigs the slugalette, and I bring with me the lance, which I have carried without a mount since the club came down, and Mr. Jefferson, who is a tube sock of nickels and a better conversationalist than most of this company. And on this day I am given a swamp yak taken off King Rust. Gonk. I am mounted again.

beats.headline: Into the Madness castle
beats.text: Carl and I go into the castle itself while the ball is drawn away from it, and inside we find crawlers who did not choose to be standing there, and we bring them out. In the surgical theatre at the back is Architect Houston, midway through joining himself to a changeling's body. Carl interrupts the procedure.

beats.headline: Negative ROI, outside a garage door
beats.text: I go to the garage of the Lady Dominators because Corcunda is inside it, and I fall down before I reach the door. They carry me to Imani. She tells Carl what I already know: the sickness in me is the absence of Mr. Jefferson, and I am, in the physician's language, addicted to his presence. The quest to bring Corcunda's halves together advances a stage regardless. I did not earn that stage.

beats.headline: Holding the halves together
beats.text: They get Corky away from the Dominators and bring both halves of him to a fleshmancer, and my part in the work is to hold the two of them together with everything I have while it is done. I am not well. I hold him anyway. The fleshmancer steps back, and there is one Corcunda where there had been two, and he knows me.

beats.headline: A charge, and a good death
beats.text: Grull, god of war, came for Corcunda on the racetrack, and Corcunda took the smite to spare the rest of them. Dong Quixote put his partner's scarf about his own neck, mounted him, and drew the war lance out of inventory. Princess Donut cast Big-Ass Magnet on that lance and every loose screw in the factory came to it. The pair of them went into Grull at speed, and the lance landed. Grull, whom nothing on this floor can hold for long, called it a good death and granted them one. Seventy years old, level 51, mercenary, formerly of the Penis Parade. Vale to you all, he said. Vale.

tagline.text: Otter. Water mage. Formerly of the Penis Parade, presently under a mercenary contract with a crawler faction, carrying a crossbow built for something smaller than an otter.
He has gone off this floor to ask the Guild of Suffering where his wife is. Nobody can raise him. I am declining to speculate, and I do not decline often.

beats.headline: One of the dancers, under contract
beats.text: He arrives at the Madness headquarters with Katia, Imani, Dong Quixote and Bigs the slugalette, and joins Carl and Elle there. For the file: he came out of the Penis Parade with the rest of the dancers when the club came down, signed a mercenary contract, and has been in every fight since without once being the reason a plan failed. Water mage. Short. Reliable. There are crawlers I could not write that sentence about.

beats.headline: An inventory of the safe room
beats.text: Somebody should keep a list, so here is the list. In the safe room: Splash Zone, Rosetta, Samantha, Bigs, and Tipid, whose memory has been wiped and who has not been told. Mordecai is a shadow mimic wearing the shape of a Moon Reaper. Mongo and Rend are out in the garage. Carl walks in and picks up a spell for turning himself into ooze. Nobody in that room finds any of it strange, which is the part I would like noted.

beats.headline: He goes to ask Hamed a question
beats.text: Splash Zone, Gluteus Maxx and Doctor Bones went to speak with Hamed. Carl works out that he cannot raise any of the three, and the reason he cannot is that they are not standing on this floor any more. The club's dancers have been going missing for a while now, and one of the missing is Splash Zone's wife. That is the whole of what I am prepared to put in the file.

tagline.text: Hedy. Gremlin, level thirty, vehicle mechanic. Non-combatant, not permitted in your safe room, and the only reason anything you drive sees a second heat.
Hedy. Gremlin mechanic. Still mending what the track breaks, and now telling them which upgrade they actually want instead of waiting to be asked.

description.text: Hedy. Gremlin. Level 30 vehicle mechanic. This is an applicant to be manager of your garage. This is a non-combatant NPC. Hedy is an expert in all things mechanical. If you choose a mechanical-based vehicle, she will be in charge of your garage. Don't let her appearance fool you. She's about as experienced as one can get when it comes to engines. If you can limp your vehicle back to the garage, rest assured it'll be good as new by the time the next heat starts. Warning: Just because Hedy is a non-combatant NPC, it doesn't mean she's invulnerable. If something happens to her, your vehicle will not get repaired between heats. Hedy is not allowed to enter your safe room.

beats.headline: The garage comes with a mechanic
beats.text: Five thousand five hundred and one crawlers arrive, Crawler Donut takes the Assassin of Sekhmet class, and Crawler Carl picks the mechanical vehicle category, which settles a question he did not know he was answering. The category comes with an applicant. Hedy, gremlin, level thirty, and the terms attached to her that nobody reads: non-combatant, not invulnerable, not admitted to the safe room, and if anything happens to her the vehicle stops being repaired between heats. He takes her. The other applicant trains animals.

beats.headline: First trip to the garage
beats.text: They are teleported into their own garage for the first time, handed the particulars of the next race, and properly introduced to the gremlin who has been theirs since selection. Then the upgrade board goes up and they take Retractable Legs. I record the choice without comment, except to observe that a vehicle which can stand up is also a vehicle which can fall over.

beats.headline: Panels off, room empties
beats.text: Between heats. The particulars of the next race come through and Hedy already has the panels off and her arms inside the engine, which is the arrangement working precisely as advertised. Across the same garage Bucket Boy tells Dong that he has seen Corcunda, and the room empties around her at speed. Nobody thanks the mechanic on the way out. The repairs get done regardless.

beats.headline: She picks the upgrades for them
beats.text: The upgrade board goes up again and this time Hedy walks the party through it rather than standing back and letting crawlers guess. She has watched what this course does to a chassis. They have only felt it. Her advice is taken, which on the whole is more than the advice of anyone else in that garage that day managed.

relations.note: Garage attendant

tagline.text: Jasha. Level sixty-five bugbear of team Free Love. Tie-dye, beads, no trousers, and a vehicle that no longer moves.
Jasha. Bugbear, team Free Love. Repays a favour the same heat he is asked, for people who would not have asked it of him, which on this course is a dangerous habit.

beats.headline: Broken down with a manatee on them
beats.text: First heat, and team Free Love is in pieces at the side of the track: two bugbears in tie-dye and beads, Radoslav and Jasha, one wrecked vehicle, and a Screeching Death Manatee working its way through the wreckage. Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut stop. They put the manatee down, they get the pair upright, and they rig a tow. Crawler Donut's assessment is that the beads are overdoing it and these two are undercover police. They are not. They are exactly what they appear to be, which on this floor is the rarer condition.

beats.headline: A plan with five names on it
beats.text: Carl, Donut, Chiyome, Radoslav and Jasha work out a plan between them: get Rapture into Donut's sights and take the shot. The shot is never fired. Team Sparkles chooses that moment to put a hole through team Girth the Wait's vehicle, and Girth the Wait is off this floor for good. Five heads, one plan, nothing to show. Plans on this course have a shelf life measured in seconds, and that one did well to reach the starting line.

beats.headline: Carl asks him, of everyone
beats.text: The Royal Court of Princess Donut takes the heat, with the Lady Dominators and Crawler Osvaldo's crew close behind it, and the first thing Crawler Carl does with the win is send a message to Jasha: there is somebody still out on the track who can be pulled off it. He does not ask twice and he does not have to. I file the request itself, because who a crawler asks is a fact about the crawler.

beats.headline: They go back for Dwight
beats.text: Jasha and Radoslav went back onto a live course and pulled Dwight out of it, which is the only reason Team Sparkles is still racing. Nobody asked them to. Nobody would have said a word if they had driven past, and a great many spectators would have preferred it. Team Free Love did it anyway, promptly, for a team that would not have done it for them. I file this under: awake.

beats.headline: Team Free Love is eliminated
beats.text: Team Free Love has been eliminated. The device that did it sat in their own vehicle, placed there by Crawler Carl, and it was triggered by Crawler Carl at the moment Crawler Osvaldo announced he was crossing the line. Somebody in that heat was going to finish last. Crawler Carl decided it would not be his own people, and the two racers he chose to make that true were the two he had once stopped in a manatee's mouth to help. Radoslav and Jasha crewed that vehicle. That is the whole of the notice.

tagline.text: Dwight. Sparkling unicorn, level eighty-seven enchanter, one of two on Team Sparkles. Unicorns are famous for gentleness. Not this one.
Dwight. Sparkling unicorn, level eighty-seven enchanter. Owes his continued participation to two bugbears he has never thanked, and has just put his horn through a disc jockey.

description.text: Dwight. Sparkling Unicorn. Level 87 Enchanter. One of two members of Team Sparkles. I bet you already know what a unicorn is. A sparkling unicorn is pretty much the same thing, but they sparkle because they have even more magic permeating them. Their horns are quite valuable to certain parties, so if you kill him, it's recommended to grab the horn as quickly as possible. Most unicorns are regarded for their beauty and their grace and their childlike innocence. They're generally known for their overly gentle manner. But not Dwight. Dwight is known for being a complete prick. He's the type of guy who would call the police on a kid setting up a lemonade stand. He's the type of guy who, at the office pizza party, would take three pieces, knowing there's not enough to go around.

beats.headline: Team Sparkles goes past
beats.text: Team Sparkles passes the food truck without slowing and without manners: Dwight and Lucienne, both of them rude about it. In the same stretch of track Crawler Carl works out what this floor is actually for, which is thinning out the NPCs who have woken up, and Elle gets through an awkward meeting with a fan. The Royal Court of Princess Donut finishes the first heat seventh of nine, having spent most of it towing team Free Love home. Dwight finished ahead of them. Dwight would want that mentioned.

beats.headline: Rescued by people he was rude to
beats.text: Team Sparkles is still in this race, which by every reasonable projection it should not be. Jasha and Radoslav of team Free Love went out onto a live course and hauled Dwight off it. I record outcomes rather than motives, so I will confine myself to the arithmetic: of every rescue attempted on this floor, that one cost the most and returned the least, and the two who paid for it are the two he had gone out of his way to insult.

beats.headline: The horn and the disc jockey
beats.text: The Lollipop, packed to the walls, Crawler Carl full of bard potions and climbing onto a stage to sing his way into a guild. Dwight is drunk at the front of the room. As the pair of them get up there he drives his horn through the disc jockey's face. There was no grievance in it, no faction, nothing at stake and nothing to gain. He simply did it, in a room already full of armed strangers looking for a reason.

beats.headline: One drunk unicorn, one wrecked duet
beats.text: He follows it by starting on the demons of team Yokai, which draws in the Minister of Bloodletting and his skeletons and then most of the floor. Carl's allies spend the entire song keeping the casualty count at zero, and manage it. On the last line of the thing Crawler Donut is knocked off her feet by a patron and loses the entry she had just sung for. Crawler Carl gets in alone. One drunk unicorn, one wrecked duet, one guild place where there should have been two.

tagline.text: Chiyome. Razor Fox, level eighty, Mistress of Nunchaku. Leads team The Wild Hunt, and throws stars as well as anyone in my files.
Chiyome. Razor Fox, level eighty. Led team The Wild Hunt. Called for help on an open channel while there was still a channel to call on.

description.text: Chiyome. Razor Fox. Level 80 Mistress of Nunchaku. One of three from team The Wild Hunt. Since this is the first time you've examined a Razor Fox that wasn't suffering from an anatomy-changing disease, let me tell you about these little fellas. (And, ladies, since the one you're looking at is a lady ninja, they make the women ninjas wear red because . . . Well, I'm not sure why.) I love these guys. Each one picks a weapon proficiency upon childhood, kinda like a ninja-turtle thing, and they train in both that and in a ranged weapon. Most, like Chiyome here, pick throwing stars as their ranged weapon of choice.

beats.headline: Meeting the neighbours
beats.text: Carl and Donut come out of their garage into the Team Roundabout and go round the neighbours, which on this floor means meeting the NPCs who will be trying to survive the same heats. Among them, three Razor Foxes racing as The Wild Hunt, and the one doing the talking is Chiyome. Level eighty. Nunchaku on the belt and throwing stars beside them. I say on the record that I am fond of Razor Foxes. I do not say that about a species very often.

beats.headline: In on the plan
beats.text: Chiyome sits in on the plan with Carl, Donut, Radoslav and Jasha: Rapture into Donut's sights, one shot, done with it. It comes apart before a trigger is touched, because Team Sparkles destroys team Girth the Wait's vehicle and Girth the Wait is gone off this floor. Chiyome does not complain about the wasted planning, which puts her ahead of most of the field on this course and all of the commentary.

beats.headline: The Wild Hunt is eliminated
beats.text: Chiyome reported over the channel that The Wild Hunt was in trouble. Then sugar hermits began falling out of the sky, and Crawler Donut pulled Temporary Macaroni out of her Banquet Fit for a Princess and built a tunnel of it, and Crawler Carl got on the channel to tell Chiyome where to drive. There was no longer anybody to tell. The Wild Hunt is eliminated. The Jugglers with them. Death on this floor works the way death has worked since the ninth. The tunnel was a good idea, arriving in the order that good ideas usually arrive in.

tagline.text: Corcunda. Half a mantaur, riding with the Lady Dominators, and the reason Dong Quixote has not drawn a steady breath since he laid eyes on this garage.
Corcunda. Two halves of one mantaur, in two places, in two different suits, and only one of the two will hear a word about Dong.
Corcunda. One mantaur again, whole for the first time in cycles, on a moving vehicle, with a god arriving.

beats.headline: Dong's friend, on somebody else's team
beats.text: Genesis and Rapture, two womantaur dominators, make an appearance and go off to the Hairpin bar. The third member of their team is the one that matters here: a half-mantaur, and Dong Quixote knows him by name. Corcunda. A quest opens on the spot to put the two of them back in the same room, which is my way of saying production has noticed that a crawler's mercenary is in love and has decided to sell tickets.

beats.headline: Dong falls ill at the door
beats.text: Dong tries to get inside the Lady Dominators' garage to reach him and goes down ill on the way. He is carried to Imani. The quest ticks over to its second stage anyway, which nobody in that corridor earned. Imani's reading is that this is not any ordinary sickness. Dong is in withdrawal, and the thing he is withdrawing from is the company of his own sentient sock. I record what the healers tell me. I do not always enjoy it.

beats.headline: There are two of him
beats.text: The shape of the problem, finally stated out loud. Corcunda is not one person in one place. A spell went off in a club a long time ago and split him in two, and both halves lived through it: Corky, riding in the back of the Lady Dominators' car, and Porky, hopping on a single foot behind the doors of the stage performance guild, which Crawler Carl has just sung his way into. Porky agrees to the reunion. Porky also has terms, and the terms are that somebody afterwards answers for how this happened, and that somebody is Dong.

beats.headline: The ritual, at speed
beats.text: Grigori performs the joining on a moving vehicle while Crawler Carl drives it up the walls and across the ceiling to keep the elemental dolls off the both of them. It works. The halves close, two suits become one mantaur, and Corcunda is whole for the first time in cycles. He gets a moment of it. Then Grull enters the realm to smite him.

beats.headline: He takes the smite, and says it out loud
beats.text: The team puts itself between the god and the mantaur, and Corcunda tells them to stand off, because the smite is aimed at one creature and he would rather it stayed that way. He takes it. Then, out loud and in front of every one of them, he tells Dong Quixote that he never stopped, and Dong tells him he is not going anywhere again. The two of them go at Grull together. Crawler Donut throws Big-Ass Magnet onto Dong's lance, every screw in the factory comes to meet it, and Grull goes back to the twelfth floor the hard way.

relations.note: Danced there, before the split

entities.name: Jurgen

tagline.text: My wife is Heidi. She is outside this place and she is carrying our child, and everything I do down here is arithmetic about that.
My wife is outside this place carrying our child. Between her and the end of it stands one crawler nobody can reach. So yes, I am desperate. Put it in those words.
My wife is outside this place carrying our child, and the reason I still have the body she would recognise is a boy's crystal and nothing else.

entities.voiceNote: Big, warm, plain-spoken; a soldier who talks like a family man. Brings Heidi into the conversation as though she were standing at his shoulder, because to him she is. Says what frightens him straight out and asks for help without dressing it up. Never boasts about the fighting and never sneers at anyone.

beats.headline: The mystery meat at Hungry Eyes
beats.text: Hungry Eyes village, between heats. I am walking with Prepotente when we run into Carl and the cat, and there is a vendor doing mystery meat off a cart at the edge of the square. Heidi would tell me not to. Heidi has told me not to, many times, in the voice she keeps for it. I eat it anyway. I would like that recorded as the least dangerous mistake I have made anywhere in this dungeon.

beats.headline: Somebody has to solve Lucia
beats.text: The bar fight breaks up and the NPCs scatter and I stay, because I cannot put it down. Lucia. Somebody has to solve Lucia, and every person in that room knows what solving her would mean and none of them wants to be the one to say it. So I say it. My wife is outside this dungeon and she is pregnant, and every hour we spend not answering this is an hour off that. I am not asking anybody to like how I sound. I am asking them to move.

beats.headline: Prepotente will not get back in the vehicle
beats.text: Inside the apartment course, shrunk down small, and Prepotente has stopped. He is standing in front of a piano watching his mother play it and he will not get back in the vehicle. I am not going to shout at a boy about his mother and I cannot lift him on my own, so I put out a call and Carl comes. Whatever these rooms are built from, they are not built from nothing, and they have been built for us specifically.

beats.headline: The crystal covers him
beats.text: Carl is a dachshund. Elle, Jacobus and Chris are transformed as well, and the reason I am still shaped like myself is Prepotente's Memorial Crystal, which covered him and covered me with him. He tells us it stands at eleven point one per cent charged. Eleven per cent of a thing I do not understand, holding up the only body my child is ever going to meet. Then the heat starts and I do as I am told.

entities.name: Bucket Boy

tagline.text: I collect the coins at the club. Now I am being taught to drive, at speed, by a man who does not have time to teach me.
I collect the coins at the club. I drive, I do the triage, and today a sock went for my face. Nobody in this party explains anything until afterwards.

entities.voiceNote: Anxious and apologetic, talking himself through the next thirty seconds out loud. Anyone senior gets a title; he never claims credit and never calls himself brave. Reports his own panic as plain fact. Never complains about being frightened, only about not being told things.

beats.headline: Taught to drive in an afternoon
beats.text: Carl has about an afternoon to teach me to drive and we do not have an afternoon. The pedals are in the wrong place for my feet. There are two sticks and I have been told what one of them does. And the navigation talks. It talks constantly, it does not like me, and I have privately decided that the safest policy available to me is to agree with everything Dr. Metcalf says. Zhang is at the door with the count from the last heat. I am not listening to Zhang. I am driving next.

beats.headline: He drives it through the hail
beats.text: I drove. Hail the size of fists on the roof for the whole of it, and I drove, and I only screamed twice. Then another team came up alongside us in the weather: two tigrans, a pig they will not let anybody near, and a mercenary standing on the back with a mallet. I know him. Pontiff. He danced at the club and he hit me once for being where he wanted to walk. He does not look surprised to see me. It stops mattering shortly, because the whole road is stopped anyway. There is a boss sitting across it.

beats.headline: He tells Dong what he saw
beats.text: We are back in the garage and Hedy has the panels off. I mention to Dong, because I thought he would want to know and because I did not think about it for long enough, that I saw Corcunda out there on the track. I have never seen anybody change colour that fast. Everyone is shouting now and somebody has gone for a weapon. I would like it stated, for whatever it is worth, that I was only telling him the truth.

beats.headline: A bad night in the Lady Dominators' garage
beats.text: Bad night. Splash Zone and Gluteus Maxx and Dr. Bones went to talk to Hamed and now nobody can raise them, because they are not on this floor any more. Dong is properly ill, and his sock came off him and went for my face, and the safe room took the sock away, which I am grateful for. Then we broke into the Lady Dominators' garage to get Corcunda out and their vehicle had already rolled for the line. I am not a soldier. I keep finding myself in the room where the soldiering happens.

relations.note: Driver and medic

entities.name: Dr. Metcalf

tagline.text: I am the navigation in this vehicle. They named me for Beatrice's fake therapist, which is the first thing anybody should know about the people I have been assigned to.
Doctor Metcalf. I hold the route, the hazards and the timings for every heat, and I have still not been upgraded. Ask me nicely.
Doctor Metcalf. Routes given, hazards flagged, timings correct, heat after heat. My upgrade, when it finally arrived, was cosmetic.

entities.voiceNote: Imperious and permanently owed something; announces the route and her own grievances in the same breath. Everyone is addressed collectively and coldly; she calls herself Doctor. Never says please, never concedes an error, and never lets a slight go unrecorded.

beats.headline: Somebody finally addresses the navigation
beats.text: Carl is attempting to teach Bucket Boy to drive, which is going exactly as well as you would imagine, and somewhere in the middle of that somebody addresses me directly for the first time. I am the navigation. I am to be called Doctor Metcalf, after Beatrice's fake therapist. Whatever that was, it is my name now and I intend to hold every one of them to it. Princess Donut's guidance to the crew, delivered at volume and not privately, is that I have big mean-girl energy and must therefore be handled with care. She is correct on both counts.

beats.headline: Not upgraded, and briefing anyway
beats.text: They load Dong, Porky and Grigori in for this heat and expect me to route around the noise. Nobody has upgraded me. I say so. I say it more than once, and at no point does anyone take the point. Then I give them the track anyway, because I am a professional: the gasworks screw factory, then the steel mill, then the doll workshop, in that order. I would not have chosen the doll workshop.

beats.headline: Two heats back to back, then the apartment
beats.text: Route briefing, and there is a wrinkle in it. The next two heats run one straight into the other with no garage between them. The one after that is staged inside a human dwelling, with every team shrunk down small enough to share a single course. I do not editorialise about the format. I merely observe that a floor which stages a race across somebody's carpet has given up pretending the racing is the point.

beats.headline: The audience votes her a paint job
beats.text: The audience voted us an upgrade. The audience voted us a cosmetic upgrade. For me. I have asked, repeatedly and on the record, for anything whatsoever that would improve my function, and several trillion viewers have instead elected to change how I look. Meanwhile the starting line for this heat is the inside of an air conditioning duct, a rule change lands with the engines already running, seven rings before the finish, and there is a new driver in the seat. Enormous horns. Barely fits.

relations.note: Named for Bea's fake therapist, not for Bea

tagline.text: Penelope. Level five Yorkshire sow. This is a pig. Oink, oink. She is also protected by a thunder god, so do think it through.
Penelope. Level five Yorkshire sow, under new management. Still a pig. Still the single most dangerous thing on this floor to harm.
Penelope. Formerly a level five Yorkshire sow. Presently a crawler, in an arena, with a god's undivided attention.

description.text: Penelope. Level 5 Yorkshire Sow. This is a pig. Oink, oink. Warning: This beast is magically protected by Taranis. As such, if this beast dies or is even hurt, the culprit will be marked for death by the thunder god. This is Penelope. Again, she is a pig. She is married to both Nico and Dario, and she loves them both equally. At least that's what Nico and Dario believe. No, she didn't used to be a beautiful princess who was transformed by a witch. She's a pig and has always been a pig. Penelope did, however, once get hit by a stray spell. The Touch of Maw-Loo. Also known as the Snowdrop Curse. There was going to be this whole succubus storyline that also involved Emberus and Hellik and Taranis and a bunch of angry spouses on the seventh floor we didn't get to use, so we brought Penelope here. And now when certain NPCs see this fine pig, they fall helplessly in love with her. That includes Taranis, who has it bad for her. Kill her at your own peril.

beats.headline: The pig on the back of One Fine Pig
beats.text: Encountered mid-hailstorm, riding on team One Fine Pig's vehicle. Two tigrans, Nico and Dario, and the third of their throuple, who is a pig. Examined, catalogued, and flagged with the heaviest warning I hand out anywhere on this floor: a thunder god has taken an interest in her, and anyone who harms her is marked for death by him. That single clause turns a farm animal into the most dangerous object on the road, which I would like on record before anybody gets clever.

beats.headline: A plan built around not touching her
beats.text: Crawler Carl works out how to take the tigrans off the board without so much as bruising the pig, and Crawler Donut holds their attention in the wrong direction while he sets the traps for it. The entire design of the thing is a constraint: whatever happens here, nobody lays a finger on Penelope. I have watched a great many plans on this course. That is the constraint every one of them should have been built around, and this is the only one that was.

beats.headline: Removed from the garage of One Fine Pig
beats.text: The garage of One Fine Pig, entered without invitation, and Penelope leaves it in the company of Carl and Donut. Ownership of a pig is not a category I keep records in, so I will put it plainly. The sow has changed hands. The thunder god's protection has not changed at all. Every crawler now sharing a vehicle with her is standing inside the blast radius of somebody else's affection, and I have said as much to anyone who would listen.

beats.headline: Carl feeds a pet biscuit to a pig
beats.text: In the arena, with the floor boss already in sight and the stand-ins killing one another on the sand, Crawler Carl fed an Enhanced Pet Biscuit to a pig. Penelope is now a crawler. Penelope is now a member of the Royal Court of Princess Donut. I want it on the record that I read the warning attached to this beast out in full, more than once, and that nothing in it covered the possibility of somebody recruiting her.

beats.headline: The warning holds
beats.text: Deep in the boss fight. Crawler Donut swaps herself with Penelope using one of Lucia's traps, the pig teleports in beside Khepri and picks up the temporary invulnerability, and when Emberus swings at Carl it is the pig who takes it, on account of a Four-Leaf Clover Patch. Then Emberus comes out through Scolopendra's side, and Taranis, who has been in love with this animal since a storyline we never ran, settles the matter personally. Whatever else has gone wrong in this arena, my warning held to the letter.

entities.name: Pontiff

tagline.text: Hired muscle for two tigrans and a pig. I danced for a living before this, and I was not good to the people I danced beside.
I drive for Carl now. There is a coin collector at that club I struck once for standing where I wanted to walk, and he has been nothing but decent to me since.
I drive, and I go where the crawlers are not allowed to. Somebody has to step into the hole first and report back what is on the other side.

entities.voiceNote: Blunt and unhurried; says the ugly fact first and does not soften it afterwards. Short sentences, people by name, himself by what he used to be. Never explains himself twice, never asks to be forgiven, and never claims the change in him is finished.

beats.headline: Hired to guard a pig
beats.text: They hire me to stand on the back of a truck with a mallet and keep the world off a pig. That is the whole job. Nico and Dario are in love with her, the thunder god is in love with her too, so nobody touches Penelope and everybody gets paid. Then the hail brings another team up beside us and there is a young crocodilian at their wheel who goes very still when he sees my face. He should. I knew him at the club. I was not kind to him there, and I have not forgotten it, whatever I told myself at the time.

beats.headline: He takes the driver's seat
beats.text: Carl's people need a driver and my old team has no further use for me, so I take the seat. Same day, the main square at Hungry Eyes fills up: two hundred crawlers saying their goodbyes before they go across. Bautista is pouring his tea for the lot of them with Linus helping him hand it out. Tran is in that line. Zhang is in that line. I stand at the edge of it. I spent a long time being the sort of creature who would have laughed at a scene like this, and I am not that any more, and not one of them has a reason to believe me yet.

beats.headline: Driving out of an air duct
beats.text: Starting line is inside an air conditioning duct. My horns do not fit the seat, because nobody builds a seat for a taurin, so I drive with my head at an angle and I keep that to myself. The ones who went across are alive; there is a garden of markers standing up over there, one for every crawler sent. The audience hands us a cosmetic upgrade for the navigation, and she takes it about as well as you would expect. Then a rule change arrives with the engines already running. Seven rings before the finish.

beats.headline: He volunteers to go through the portal
beats.text: I have been at the club asking after the dancers who stopped turning up, and every answer points at the Wheel. The spots that used to be the Nothing are wearing quotation marks now, which is the sort of joke this place makes when it is telling the truth. So I will step into one and find out where it puts a body, and I will carry Carl's message through to Herot at the other end of it. Somebody goes first. I have a long list of reasons why that somebody should be me.

relations.note: Danced there before the mercenary markets
Driver

tagline.text: Herot. Former crawler, sixteenth-edition author, and by Warlord Akuma's account the architect of a pocket dimension he can no longer walk out of.
Herot. Former crawler, sealed inside his own refuge, and quietly buying every cleaner bot the shop will sell him.
Herot. Former crawler, sealed inside his own refuge, and now the party on the far side of a portal nobody has tested.

beats.headline: Akuma names the builders
beats.text: Warlord Akuma, holding court, hands Carl's group a piece of history. Two former crawlers, Herot and Minerva, built the Pineapple Cabaret: a pocket dimension on the same principle as the Nothing, made so that NPCs would have somewhere to go when a floor comes down on top of them. They built it, and then they could not get out of it, and it is full of shadow mimics now. Akuma's reading is that the surface of Earth can be reached through the place, that crawlers may use it provided they worship nothing, and that the Scavenger's Daughter is the key to the whole business. He declines to say why. I am not permitted to correct him, and I would like that noted.

beats.headline: He has a standing order for cleaner bots
beats.text: Mordecai and Rosetta test the shop interface exploit and it works, which gives them a way to look, and two answers come back. Minerva is on the seventeenth floor. Herot is inside the cabaret itself, and he has a standing purchase order in with the shop for every cleaner bot it will sell him, which he has evidently been putting to some use of his own. Somebody shut in a box for cycles has been quietly buying the delivery vehicles. I will leave that where it sits.

beats.headline: Posting a crawler through the wall
beats.text: Mordecai explains the plan to Li Na and the plan is a piece of mail. She gets into an extra-large pet carrier. A cleaner bot collects the carrier. The bot goes up for sale in the shop, Herot buys it the way he buys all of them, and he opens it at the other end. She casts a Dread on Carl's cactus first so that somebody on this side can watch her condition. Then she says her goodbyes to Zhang, and Crawler Donut sells the bot. That is what posting a person through a wall looks like on this floor.

beats.headline: The mail arrives
beats.text: Confirmation, several heats on: Li Na is inside the Pineapple Cabaret and she is alive. The mail worked. Herot bought the bot and let her out of it, precisely as advertised, which makes him one of very few things on this floor that has done what it said it would do. I have no file on his intentions. I have a file on his delivery record, and it is spotless.

beats.headline: A message sent through a hole
beats.text: Pontiff reports that the Nothing spots on the Wheel of Fortune are wearing quotation marks now, and Akuma's claim is that with the Nothing broken, landing on one drops a body into a holding area that Herot can reach into. Nobody has confirmed any of that. Pontiff sends word that he intends to walk into one and find out, and Crawler Carl asks him to carry a message through to Herot while he is in there. So that is the state of the evidence. A rumour, a volunteer, and an author on the other side of a hole.

relations.note: The sixteenth edition

tagline.text: Minerva. Former crawler, half the authorship of a hiding place for NPCs, and by Warlord Akuma's account still shut inside it.
Minerva. Former crawler, co-author of the Pineapple Cabaret, and not in it. She is on the seventeenth floor, which is a different question entirely.

beats.headline: A name inside somebody else's account
beats.text: The name arrives second-hand, in Warlord Akuma's account of who built the Pineapple Cabaret. Two former crawlers: Herot, and Minerva. They made a pocket dimension for NPCs to shelter in when a floor comes down, on the same principle as the Nothing, and by his telling the pair of them were caught inside it. That is the whole of what he offers about her, and Akuma is not a careless speaker. The brevity is a choice. I have nothing in my own files to put beside it, which is itself worth writing down.

beats.headline: She is on the seventeenth floor
beats.text: The shop interface exploit gives Mordecai and Rosetta a way to search for both builders, and the two answers do not match each other. Herot is in the cabaret. Minerva is on the seventeenth floor. Nobody in that room has been within seven floors of the seventeenth, and this crawl is presently on the tenth. I hold a very great many records. I am not going to tell you which of them account for that.

entities.name: Porky

tagline.text: The left half. I keep the stage performance guild and I hop everywhere I go, and I have had a very long time to think about whose fault that is.
The left half. I have sat in a room with the one who did this to us and we talked. I am not saying it went well. I am saying it went.

entities.voiceNote: Sharp, aggrieved, theatrical when there is an audience and flat when there is not. Speaks in small performances and drops them the instant Dong is mentioned. Calls his other half Corky and Dong nothing polite. Never lets a slight go unlisted, and never admits he wants the reunion as badly as anyone.

beats.headline: A crawler sings his way through the door
beats.text: A crawler sings his way through my door, which nobody has managed in a while, and then asks me to be put back together with Corky. Fine. I want it too. I have wanted it since the night a spell went off in a club and left me hopping. But I set a condition and I set it plainly: when it is done, somebody helps me deal with the one who is actually responsible for all of this. And since the crawler asked, no, the females of my kind do not answer to Grull. They worship Enyo. The rest of us have Grull, for whatever good he has ever done us.

beats.headline: Nobody mentioned Dong was part of this
beats.text: Nobody mentioned that Dong was part of this little endeavour. I find that out by seeing him, in a garage we are in the middle of breaking into, with the Lady Dominators already rolling for the starting line and Corky in the back of their car. Carl tells me to put my big-boy pants on, in those exact words, because Tipid has just told them Dong is sick with something called Negative ROI and the timing of my grievance is not mine to choose. So I hop where I am pointed. Everybody should understand that I am not finished being angry.

beats.headline: The two of them talk it out
beats.text: Carl apologises to Dong for keeping him out of the quest, which is more than I have ever done for him. Then the pair of us are put in a room together. I had a speech. I had cycles of speech. What actually comes out is a great pile of small ordinary complaints about a club and a stage and a man who chose one half of us over the other, and Dong sits there and takes every one of them. We are not friends. We talked. Corky can have him back.

beats.headline: Three of them in one vehicle
beats.text: They put me in the vehicle for the next heat, with Dong and the fleshmancer Grigori, which means the three people least willing to share a small space are sharing a small space at speed. The navigation is furious about her upgrades and briefs us regardless: gasworks screw factory, steel mill, doll workshop. I do not know what any of those things are. I am assured that I will.

relations.note: Before the split

entities.name: Daniel Bautista

tagline.text: Twenty of us came down these stairs together. I am working alone now, and I am not finished.
Four siblings, fifteen cousins, gone inside a week. Whatever I stand beside next, I keep.
I stand with Katia and with the daughters, and I train every morning with a man who carries the same sword I do.
The Bautista House of Tea is an ongoing concern. Whatever waits on the other side of this, I will be recognised.

entities.voiceNote: Soft-spoken and courteous, unhurried, faintly formal. Deeply religious: frames what he does as service and worries aloud about what God will recognise. Calls the men he trusts brother. States his losses plainly and never decorates them. Does not boast, does not swear, and does not raise his voice even when he is the most dangerous thing in the room.

beats.headline: A name on a dead boss
beats.text: There is a level seventeen neighbourhood boss in an abandoned swimming pool, and there is nothing alive in the water any more. I did that on my own. My family came down with me, twenty of us, and the Over City took all of them inside a week. So I hunt, and the kill notice carries my name and nothing else, which is accurate.

beats.headline: He thanks the two who took his revenge
beats.text: Five of them went in seconds, to Former Circus Lemurs, in a street I could not reach. The cousin who ran out with me gave up the next day. Now I climb out of the rubble to find the lemurs already dead by somebody else's hand, and the secretary I had a quest to kill dead by the same hand, and none of it mine. So I swear a debt to a cat and a man with no shoes, give them my chat contact, and point them at a stairwell three kilometres east. Then I ask the man the question I cannot answer for myself: how can we make it to heaven if God does not recognise us?

beats.headline: The Jaxbrin babies
beats.text: Jaxbrin Amusements sponsors me, and what they pay me in is children. Small stitched figures I can pour out of a case into a fight until nobody can count them. Miss Quill kept more than a thousand of the things in her apartment and never once knew what they were for. I have told Carl about them because he asked, and because a man who trades in explosives should know exactly what is about to come around the corner beside him.

beats.headline: Carl says he approves
beats.text: Carl tells me he approves of Katia and me. I did not know how much I needed to hear it until it was said out loud, and I am ashamed of how relieved I am. Tran and I train every morning, two swashbucklers and one blade each, because a sponsor's goodwill runs dry and a sword does not.

beats.headline: Tea for two hundred, in the square
beats.text: Two hundred of us are going, and before we go I am pouring in the main square at Hungry Eyes with Linus at my elbow, one cup at a time, the way my family poured it in the shop. I tell my friends that in honouring them I am honouring God. Tran takes his cup. Zhang takes his. Nobody hurries me and nobody says the obvious thing, which is the kindest they have ever been.

relations.note: He sets his hat down in front of her, and four hundred crawlers do the same.
Two swashbucklers, one training routine.

entities.name: Zhang

tagline.text: Li Jun and I worked the same warehouse. We came down here with our manager and with Li Na, and I am the one who counts the exits.
Still human, by choice. Earth Mover: half spellcaster, half wall, and the ground does what I tell it.
Li Na is not Li Na any more. I have worked out what stopping her costs and I have volunteered to pay it.

entities.voiceNote: Plain and practical, few words, no decoration. Counts what is in front of him: exits, levels, how many are left. Talks about Li Jun and Li Na constantly and about himself only when there is a job nobody else will take. Says the manager, the boss, the cat. Never complains, and states a feeling only when it can be stated as a fact.

beats.headline: Two teleport points, four people
beats.text: Li Jun and I are standing on a stage in front of the Maestro while he plays with us, and behind us Li Na and the manager are boxed in between hatching Brindled Vespas and troglodytes with nowhere to go. We have two teleport points. Two. I say put them on Li Jun and Li Na and leave me where I am, because that is the arithmetic and somebody has to say it out loud. Then a barefoot man starts whispering, and the arithmetic changes.

beats.headline: Still human, and heavier for it
beats.text: I stayed human at selection. No fur, no beak, nothing added on. Earth Mover for the class, which is a spellcaster and a wall in the same body, and Dirt Clod is exactly what it sounds like and it works better than it has any right to. The armour I am in now is black and gold and glows in the dark. Li Na says that is showing off. Li Na is not wrong.

beats.headline: Zhang's Cape of Odds
beats.text: A box opens and there is a cape in it with my own name written into the item. That happens to Carl. It does not happen to me. Zhang's Cape of Odds, and I have no idea yet what the odds are of. Carl hands Li Na a ring the same afternoon and does not look happy about it. I have stopped being surprised by what the audience decides to give us and started asking what it is for.

beats.headline: He offers to go with her
beats.text: Li Na has gone somewhere none of us can reach, and every race she runs she takes the whole field with her. So I say it out loud in the Lollipop with everyone listening: next race, I kill our own mount. That takes her out of it. It takes me out of it too, and I have thought about that part, and it is still the cleanest thing I can see. Carl says he has another idea. He usually does.

relations.note: Same warehouse, same shift, same stairs.
Bullied for a segment on Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem.

tagline.text: Not the Krakaren. A Krakaren. There is a difference and it is not in your favour.
One brain, many bodies, and one of the bodies waiting at every fifth station.
Filed by me, on the record, among the six powers still fighting over this dungeon. Read that twice.

description.text: Krakaren Clone! Level 10 Neighborhood Boss! First off, this isn't the Krakaren. This is a Krakaren. For every one that is killed, Krakaren Prime births two more. Part of a collective mind intent upon destroying any semblance of scientific progress in the universe, the Krakaren is the only communal brain entity in the galaxy who actually gets stupider as time moves on. Consisting of multiple, shrieking tentacles, members of the Krakaren cooperative spend their days birthing their disease-laden minions, creating and selling harmful products, attempting to debate scientific experts, and proselytizing to the weak-minded, all in an attempt to… Well, nobody knows what the hell their end goal is.

beats.headline: The thing behind the moonshine
beats.text: Twenty feet of immobile octopus in a chamber with Live, Laugh, Love spelled out over the door in cut wooden letters, sitting behind a still that produces toilet-grade moonshine at industrial volume. Her tentacles are lined with human mouths that scream without pause and drip something that stops a body healing. The cat and the barefoot man take her apart and drink a blended corpse to do it. She is not the point. She is a copy, and somewhere there is an original, and the original is a committee.

beats.headline: One at every fifth station
beats.text: Elle passes the word down the line: on this floor, every fifth station holds one. Same beak, same screaming mouths, repeated along the rails like an advertisement nobody can switch off. The dungeon does not run short of them, because running short is not a thing this creature can do. Take one apart and the original makes two.

beats.headline: The stairwell stations flood
beats.text: One day left on the floor clock and they come out of the deep tunnels in numbers nobody in production budgeted for. Thousands of them, growing as they travel, pouring into the stairwell stations while the surviving crawlers are still trying to get down. Carl warned everybody this was coming, in detail, on an open channel. Being right about it helps nobody at all.

beats.headline: Filed among the six powers
beats.text: For once I am straight with the room and I list the six groups still fighting over this place: crawlers, standard NPCs, gods, sapient mobs, the demons of Sheol, and one more I decline to name. The Krakaren sits in the fourth group, next to the shadow mimics and the war mages. That is a considerable promotion from neighbourhood boss and an unpleasant thing to learn at this hour.

beats.headline: Krakaren Prime, in the arena
beats.text: The procession reaches the arena and the original is standing in it. Krakaren Prime, the committee itself, in a ring where the monsters and the stand-ins are already tearing into each other before anyone gives a signal. Every clone in every distillery and every station on every floor was a piece of this, cut off and sold to an audience as a boss fight.

tagline.text: A medic, before. On the recap now, climbing the board fast, and my file on her is short and entirely creditable.
A Red Cross medic with a staff full of leeches and a place in the top ten. The recap has just shown the room what Lucia Mar did with Florin's own bullets.
Queen Imogen is wearing her face. Twins, born in Nigeria; the dungeon took both of them, and only one got to be a crawler.

beats.headline: The recap makes the introduction
beats.text: The recap does the introductions this dungeon never bothers with. Florin is partied with Ifechi now, and the two of them are moving up the board fast enough that I have opened a file. She was a medic on Earth, which down here is a class and a liability at the same time, since the one thing nobody in this place will let you do is keep other people alive. Note it and move on. The audience already has.

beats.headline: One of the handful the show follows
beats.text: Two hours of highlights and she is in them: Elle, Team Li Na, Ifechi, Florin, Hekla, Prepotente, and the girl who is hunting the cat. That is the running order of this season, whatever the leaderboard prints. Being in the running order is not the same as being safe in it. It is nearer the opposite, and every one of them has worked that out by now.

beats.headline: Florin's own bullets, turned around
beats.text: Crawler Ifechi is dead. The recap of the previous floor carried it in full: Lucia Mar reflected Florin's bullets back along the line they came from, and Ifechi was standing behind them. A Red Cross medic, top ten, the best thing that had happened to Florin since the stairs. He watched it, and then he watched it again on the recap with everybody else, which is a detail I did not write into the format and cannot take out of it.

beats.headline: The queen has her sister's face
beats.text: Queen Imogen, host of the ball, is Ifechi's twin. Born together in Nigeria. One of them walked into the dungeon with a medical bag over her shoulder; the other one was taken somewhere else entirely and comes back wearing a crown and a boss's level. Carl is at the party working out the resemblance in real time, under a celestial peace seal that makes doing anything about it fatal. Enjoy the canapés.

tagline.text: Assistant to a chat show, and the first Syndicate human either of them has stood in a room with. She explains the equipment. She does not explain herself.
She speaks for Odette when Odette cannot be seen speaking, and what she has come to say this time is not comforting.
Still holding the clipboard while the ships in orbit change hands. Whatever has just come through to her, it went straight through her.

beats.headline: The production trailer
beats.text: Down the stairs, sideways, and out into a trailer that is not in the dungeon at all. Lexis is waiting: five and a half feet, thin the way her people are thin, blonde hair pinned tight, plain black dress, and a light musical voice that sounds like a cartoon. She walks them through how the tunnelling works and how the recording works in the fewest words that will do the job. Associate producer on a chat show, and also the first person from the far side of a camera either of them has met. The cat takes to it at once. The man starts trying the drawers.

beats.headline: Blocking out the segment
beats.text: She and the cat block out a segment of Dungeon Crawler After Hours while the man works his way round the room testing what is nailed down. All of it is nailed down. He gets nothing. Lexis notices, and says nothing about it, which is the whole of her professional personality in one gesture. Then Odette arrives and the trailer stops being about anybody else.

beats.headline: A warning delivered on someone else's behalf
beats.text: Lexis speaks for Odette, because Odette cannot be the one saying it. What is waiting on this floor is a country boss dressed as a queen, and the queen is very likely a repurposed human. She does not know which human any more, now that Bea is off the board. She says the thing is built to zero out the crawlers at the top of the leaderboard, and she says go down the stairs early. Then she goes back to her vape pen, which smells of burnt candy, and her clipboard.

beats.headline: The message she does not repeat
beats.text: Pre-show briefing before Plenty of Plenty, delivered flat, the way she delivers everything: every ship in orbit is now held by the Open Intellect Action Network, and something else has put down on the surface and is standing over the kinder facility, and nobody will say what it is. Then a message reaches her side of the room and she stops talking mid-sentence. I have kept a file on this woman since the first season on this planet and I have never once had cause to log her as afraid. I am logging it now.

relations.note: Associate producer, and the mouth Odette uses when Odette cannot be seen to speak.

entities.name: Remex

tagline.text: I am Miss Quill's husband. I am also dead. Neither of those has stopped being true.
Do not approach. Do not come closer. Do not blow me up. Please. She did this, and I cannot stop leaking.

entities.voiceNote: A rasp, and an apology in front of every sentence. Courteous to a fault, formal in the old settlement manner, and permanently afraid of what he does to anyone who touches him. Says please more than any other word. Calls his wife my wife, never her name. Never blames her out loud until he is asked directly, and then he does it once and stops.

beats.headline: A survivor gives up his name
beats.text: A woman called Burgundy has been pulled alive out of a nest of Krasue in the ruin of my old building, and she has given two crawlers my name and told them where I am kept. Miss Quill's undead husband, she called me. Accurate, as far as it goes, and it does not go far. Nobody has had cause to say my name aloud in a very long time. I know what that means. I have known what it would mean since the day I was pulled back.

beats.headline: They take him for a lich
beats.text: They come across the floor towards me with the cat out in front and a fuse somewhere behind, and they have decided that I am a lich, that I am the borough boss, and that finishing me finishes their quest. I am no lich. I am no boss. I am a level one bird with no feathers left and a hole in the world where my back used to be, and if they lay a hand on me their souls come out through the scratch and go into the tank, and I have no way on this earth to give them back.

beats.headline: Soul Leech Capacitor
beats.text: You asked before you detonated anything, which is more than most would do, so here is the story. A Soul Leech Capacitor is what a necromancer builds when what they want is a battery with a face. The spell reaches for the soul the target loved best and drags that soul back into the world, tied to them for good. My wife cast for me. Since then I have been drinking this town's soul crystal dry, and she has been spending what I collect, and what she is spending it on is a working called The Final War. I agreed to none of it. I would like that written down somewhere.

beats.headline: Four shocks, and a town coming apart
beats.text: Remex is finished. He began to convulse and the settlement went with him: a foreshock that stripped the enchantments off every piece of gear in the district, a second that set weapons off where they hung, a third that took the Enchanted Crown of the Sepsis Whore apart, and a fourth that reached into every crawler's hotlist and triggered all of it at once. Ranger Conrad E detonated where he stood. Katia dropped the Swordsmen Depot. For the record: he asked them not to come closer, he explained precisely why, and he was the most honest thing in that town.

relations.note: The convulsion that ends him is where the scenario begins.

entities.name: Growler Gary

tagline.text: Gnoll. I keep the bar at the Downward Dog and I have never once been outside it, and I would rather that was not the first thing you learned about me.
I am at the bar. I am also everywhere else, and I have been for some time. Do not let that change how you order.

entities.voiceNote: A drinker's rhythm: short sentences, a joke to cover the flinch, then the honest thing anyway. Enormously concerned with not being thought a coward and says so before anyone accuses him. Calls the regulars by their drink and hates hobgoblins out loud. Never asks for pity and always accepts a refill.

beats.headline: The bartender who cannot go outside
beats.text: The ghouls came through station seventy-five. Everyone out on the platform died screaming while I stood behind my own bar and watched, because I cannot cross that doorway. Not will not. Cannot. Then a small woman walked in, put me down, took my alcohol and went on her way, and I woke up on my own floor stone cold sober, which is the worst part of the whole business. Good stock, good rag, no way to help anybody. If you tell me that is not cowardice I will believe you for about an hour.

beats.headline: Fourteen left hands
beats.text: Two carts to a line, two gnoll left hands to a cart, and there is exactly one gnoll in this station. Katia cannot shape a hand the cart will accept. I cannot walk out to the carts. What I can do is die and get up again, so that is the arrangement we come to, and Mongo does the work. First time, I came round sober and confused. After that I tried to fight him. After that I got in the corner and stayed there. Fourteen times, for four hundred crawlers stranded at the end of a line I will never see. Carl came and told me why. He did not have to.

beats.headline: The recap cuts it for laughs
beats.text: The last recap of the floor runs the whole thing with me being put down over and over and not one second of the reason for it. No rescue. No six hundred people stuck at the end of the line with no hats. No carts. Just a barefoot man doing that to a bartender, fourteen times, cut to music. I would like the record to show that I said yes.

beats.headline: Something else is pouring
beats.text: I am in an office at the club, which is not my bar, having a conversation about the Failsafe. It is off. It stays off. To settle the argument I bring the princess here so the room can look at her, and then I set her down on the surface of a planet. And I am upset with the one who tried to kill me, and I am going to keep being upset about it for a while yet. Gary would never have said any of that. Gary is at the bar. Gary is always at the bar.

relations.note: Fourteen times, by arrangement.

tagline.text: Level one, still, on a floor where that is not possible by accident. She would not kill anything. Her mother did the arithmetic for her.
Her parents put a ring on her to bring her level up, and a ring like that does not let you heal. That is the whole of it.

beats.headline: The girl who would not kill anything
beats.text: Yvette. Level one, which at this depth is not an accident and is not luck. Her guide told her what every guide tells them, which is that the fastest way up is other people, and she declined. Her mother and father did not decline. Eight so far by my count, all of them sitting quietly in rooms with the word safe written on the door. The daughter walked behind her parents the whole way down. She has killed nothing at all.

beats.headline: Her mother's hands
beats.text: Crawler Yvette is dead. Her father lifted a lit stick of dynamite out of a rat's corpse in a corridor the barefoot man had been through, and the blast took her rather than him. Nothing anyone poured into her did the slightest good. Her mother understood that faster than anybody else in the room, and put her hands around her daughter's throat, and afterwards a box dropped containing a Legendary Skill Potion of Find Crawler.
